In this study, teaching learning-based optimization (TLBO) is utilized for tuning the adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) with the integration of DGs into DC microgrid system. In order to determine the effectiveness of the TLBO-based ANFIS, the system has been checked by diverse dynamic conditions like nominal state, changes in irradiance (1000–500 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) 50% increment in AC load at 1.5 Sand 50% increment in DC load. As per simulation findings, the proposed TLBO-based ANFIS yields better enrichment in all considered dynamic conditions.

articleTitle: Self distancing tracker to prevent COVID - 19 by facial recognition using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research paper gives the precise detail about an important way of detection and recognition of human faces using python and importing OpenCV as a main library in the python language. A brief idea of the report contains the ways where in a proposed system to keep on tracking the face of people right from the starting of the execution and continuously detect via the camera which is accessed by an OpenCV package and measure the distance using an algorithm And once if the distance gets decreases or comes less than the proposed limit, an alert message with a sound producing an alarm using the play sound library is given as the output. The practical working of this concept takes place between multiple faces and output will be produced based on the distance among faces, which will be wise enough for the people to get maintained social distancing through facial recognition for the better prevention of COVID-19 in impromptu in real time. This method could be an useful or an advisable one compared to the other several ways of facial recognition for the social distancing. And hence this execution can be utilized or brought out in various new strategies in machineries, smartphones, and also in several software applications.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Arbiter PUFs for ideal Cryptographic Key Generation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: It is critical in today's security-conscious environments and communications to create unique identities, and this can be done with software or hardware. Hardware can create a reliable and unique identity with less complexity than software because software requires more complex algorithms to keep the secret hidden from the adversaries. PUF is the name of one such basic circuit. Even when made using a nominally identical process, no two physical objects are exactly the same. When presented with a binary input, a PUF circuit responds with a binary, device-unique output. A PUF circuit is designed to be sensitive to manufacturing process variations. PUF as a hardware primitive is used as an authentication device in the real-world practical application scheme. The proposed IoT node-to-node mutual authentication algorithm does not require a server or a trusted third party. FPGA boards are used to implement the algorithm's main modules, such as the Nonce generation logic and the unclonable response generation logic. In spite of identity theft, PUF-based authentication schemes have the assurance that malicious parties cannot replace the intended PUF-based node.

articleTitle: A multiobjective based Encryption scheme for content-based addressing in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In today's world, due to the advanced technology development, the users store their information in an online platform called cloud. There are different types of storage mechanisms like Rados (object oriented), Cassandra (key oriented) and Interplanetary file storage system (IPFS) used in the cloud. Among these, the IPFS is the best storage mechanism because it creates the address based on the content. But individually IPFS suffers from the replicate problem. Hence, it combined with the Block chain technology. Even though it combined with the block chain technology it suffered from the data privacy and replicated data. In the existing system, the Cuckoo search optimization finds the optimal key and the similarity distance metric used for the analysis. Due to the selected distance metric, there is replicated data in the system. Hence, in this paper, a multi-objective optimization is proposed for finding the optimal key and distance metric. In this, the forest optimization determined the key based on the input data for Advanced standard encryption. Then, it also determined the squared Euclidean distance is the best metric for reducing the upload time and saving the storage space on the server. The proposed approach reduced its upload speed to 10.9% and 11.8% as compared to the existing approach.

articleTitle: The Role of Multimedia and Voice Monitoring Technology in College English Intelligent Classroom Guiding
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the continuous development of the social economy and the rapid development of science and technology in our country, the computer network has been widely used. In this environment, the multimedia network language room has emerged. The appearance and development of multimedia teaching have created good conditions for the classroom education of teachers. At present, most secondary vocational schools have realized specialized multimedia teaching, such as teaching, practical training and experiment. In this paper, a transfer learning model algorithm for speech segmentation based on few features is designed, and the classical deep learning VGG-NET network is modified. Residual learning unit is added into the model to deepen the depth of the network. Experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Application of Social Networks Data Mining in Strengthening College Ideological Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Application of social networks data mining in strengthening college ideological environment is studied in this manuscript. In the actual application of machine learning, the number of features is often large, and there may be irrelevant features, and there may also be interdependence between the features. However, a large amount of the above classification work is based on a single-dimensional complex network, with this basis, this paper defines the novel mining algorithm. The model is applied into the scenarios and the experimental results are also tested.

articleTitle: Smart Parking Fee Detection Using Contour Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In today's world, many people are traveling in their own vehicles. The manual parking bills in public areas which leads to huge traffic or queue are formed for collecting the parking bills. Manual parking fee generation is a time consuming process, there is a possibility for loss of paper parking bills which leads to a lot of confusion, and sometimes there is lots of miscalculation in the parking fee. To reduce the time, the proposed model uses a vehicle number plate for the detection of parking fees. The automatic parking bill system in public areas through the vehicle number plate recognition will increase the convenience of collecting parking fees without the has s les of using paper bills. The system uses image processing that is Python OpenCV for localizing number plates for the billing system. It uses a Canny edge detection algorithm for localizing number plates from car images followed by character segmentation and uses a trained Python PyTesseract package is used for the recognition of characters in the number plate and generating a parking fee bill. As the result the system has reduced the interaction of humans and paper bills, time consumption is less. Cannon edge detection has improved the accuracy in the identification of the vehicle. The parking fee bill is generated at the time of exit of the vehicle from the parking area.

articleTitle: Image Processing Approaches for Oral Cancer Detection in Color Images
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Lips, two-thirds of the tongue and inner cheek lining are all common places for oral cancer to form. It can also arise in hard and soft palates, pharynx, and sinuses. Head and neck cancers are subtypes of this malignancy. Unless detected and treated early on, oral can be dangerous. Using microscopic biopsy images, the researchers were able to detect mouth cancer and non-cancerous lesions. Using cutting-edge techniques, it is possible to histologically diagnose oral lesions. For example, enhancing microscopic images involves transforming them from RGB to L*a*b color space, classifying the colors using k-means clustering, segmenting the nuclei, and obtaining and classifying their features.

Index Terms: Head And Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

articleTitle: Internet of Things based Automobile Accident Detection System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The social and economic impacts led by road accidents in highways and freeways are huge. Immediate attention has to be given so that escorting the injured can be done faster. The incoming trend in automotive technologies can offer better assistance for the injured with the information being transmitted faster and reducing the response time. Accurately determining the predefined values of a vehicle will help in detecting and reporting accidents to the external control units, so that severity can be determined and can offer the necessary assistance by accurately defining the geographical area

articleTitle: Investigation Relationship between Network Congestion and Vehicle Density in VANETs
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Nowadays, overcrowding in transportation Control in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) is an important research area. VANETs have dynamically changing network topology and huge movability, which makes the design congestion solution challenging. Thus, research is required about Congestion with other factors, and Node density is a significant factor that affects Congestion. In this article, the relationship between vehicle compactness and network obstruction in VANETs is analyzed. The variation in vehicle occupancy is investigated against network quality; the outcomes manifest the worst complex congestion with high vehicle density.

articleTitle: Predicting Chronic Kidney Disease by Applying Feature Engineering & Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Persistent disease is defined as one that develops slowly but remains constant over time. One of the long-term diseases is chronic kidney disease. There are various stages of CKD severity. While therapy has been shown to postpone improvement, it becomes very serious over time, and if not managed properly, CKD can lead to cardiovascular disease in the early stages. If our kidneys aren't working properly, we'll need dialysis or a kidney transplant. The final stage of renal disease is kidney failure, which is treated with dialysis or a kidney transplant. The classification techniques are the main subject of this research, which includes logistic regression, tree-based decision tree, and random forest and analyzed the performance of these techniques.

articleTitle: Construction of Carbon Emission Model of Building Energy System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: As the infrastructure of urban buildings, the building energy system is an important source of building energy consumption and carbon emissions. With the promotion of national energy-saving and emission-reduction policies, more and more new energy and renewable energy utilization technologies are put into use in the construction field. The degree of impact of these technologies on the environment from the perspective of global warming requires a reasonable evaluation. Based on big data, this paper studies the construction of the carbon emission model of the building energy system based on big data, and optimizes the calculation accuracy of carbon emission.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing and Predictive Costing in healthcare
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: To improve the current pricing model of medical services, this proposal aims to study the current pricing model, build and implement a dynamic pricing model for hospitals. Capital equipment required for the hospital infrastructure is inherently expensive. For example, real estate, CT Scan (Computerized Tomography), MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) machines, Surgery theatres etc. Due to the high capital costs, the price of services invariably remains high. The objective of dynamic pricing would be to charge appropriate prices to different groups of people based on parameters like convenience, time, geography, market segment, skill potential, equipment use, customer type and lastly by each service. Dynamic pricing model is proposed as an apt pricing strategy that enables organization achieving better results through balancing the load between peak hours /nonpeak hours and improving customer experience by providing value addition through personalized service. This also increases the brand value of the company by improving geographic reach by creating positive impacts in mind of customers.

articleTitle: Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Speed Control Based on Modified Active Disturbance Rejection Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In the interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) speed control system, the conventional PI controller cannot satisfy the requirements of rapid response and small overshoot under the condition of acceleration, deceleration and sudden disturbance. In order to solve this problem, a modified ADRC system is proposed in this paper to improve the dynamic performance and disturbance rejection ability. Firstly, the basic ADRC theory and IPMSM mathematical model are introduced. Then, the modified ADRC system is proposed. Finally, the experiments of modified ADRC system and PI control system have been carried out to validate the effectiveness of the modified ADRC system. Experimental results show the proposed method reduces the overshoot and shortens the response time.

articleTitle: Character Recognition of Historical and Cultural Relics Based on Digital Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: For the purpose of the inheritance of traditional culture, based on the visual identification system, based on the urban planning, the design research of the identification system is carried out especially for the historical and cultural relics of the traditional style area. Digital image processing includes 8 items: point operation, geometric processing, image enhancement, image restoration, image morphology processing, image coding, image reconstruction, and pattern recognition. Aiming at the problems of low recognition accuracy and long recognition time in traditional handwriting recognition methods, a handwriting recognition method based on digital image processing is proposed to recognize historical and cultural relics.

articleTitle: A Combined Model of NLP with Business Process Modelling for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Natural language processing is one of the main sub-field of artificial intelligence, where all end users of internet in real time use their native language to extract the required information. This work concentrates on the sentiment analysis on social media, which comprises of text, numbers, hashtags, symbolic representations and much more. It becomes tedious in handling these unstructured data. Hence, the solution is to makes use of basic NLP tools, then implement Markov decision process in order to process the translation of the native language input to a SQL query. An implementation idea for business process models is also incorporated to have different analysis states of the input data. The accuracy achieved through Deep learning models in this proposed work are greater compared to the other machine learning and normal corpus methodologies.

articleTitle: 0.7 V UWB LNA for 2.1-13.2 GHz Wireless Applications using 65-nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The paper presents a wideband input matching LNA with a high gain that is able to work from 2.1 GHz to 13.2 GHz. This LNA is devised on 65 nm CMOS technology using BSIM model. It consists of three stages. In the initial stage, the basic RL circuit is implemented using biasing conditions. Here, M2 is used to enhance the gain. The first and second stages are connected with the help of a series inductor and a coupling capacitor which is able to provide maximum power transfer. The second and third stages are connected using T-network in order to boost the gain in the entire bandwidth. The input and output return losses are less than −10 dB for the desired bandwidth. The power gain of greater than 15 dB is obtained in frequency range of 2.1 GHz to 13.2 GHz. The minimum noise figure of 5.5 dB is obtained at 5 GHz. The 1-dB compression point and intercept point (IIP3) are −24.5 dBm and −10 dBm respectively. The power dissipation of proposed circuit is 2.9 mW.

articleTitle: Power Efficient Charge Pump with Dynamic Threshold for Implantable Biomedical Transducers
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Implantable biomedical transducers generate ultralow voltages which need to be boosted for further usage in energy harvesting. This paper presents a power efficient charge pump with dynamic threshold realized using tree topology to boost such ultralow voltages. The proposed charge pump has shown a better performance over other converters in terms of power efficiency and output current for such ultralow voltage applications. The performance has been validated through mathematical analysis and simulations. Three voltages, 130mV, 140mV and 150 mV have been boosted to 0.5 V to measure the performance of proposed charge pump. The voltage source has been realized using photovoltaic (PV) cell. The simulations have been carried out with LTspice in 0.18µm CMOS technology using TSMC model.

articleTitle: Construction of food digital ID and intelligent monitoring platform based on blockchain traceability and GPS locationing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Construction of food digital ID and intelligent monitoring system based on blockchain traceability technology is studied in this manuscript. This paper has two aspects of novelty: (1) The blockchain integration and enhancement. The decentralization of the blockchain and the mechanism of mutual verification of the block owners achieve effective proof of the transactions, the latest models are used to improve the efficiency. (2) The digital ID system design. After checking that it is correct, it encrypts the product information with its private key, digitally signs the product information and stores it in the server. (3) The implementation of the monitoring system. Distributed systems must consider the issue of data release when multiple consumers request multiple data sources at the same time, the sysmte is implemented with the coding theories. For the verification of the models, the method is simulatedand the results are convincing.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Power Splitter with linear waveguides in a Low Dielectric-Index Material
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: For two-dimensional photonic crystals involving linear waveguides on a hexagonal lattice with air holes, a Y splitter structure with high performance and 60o waveguide bends is obtained by optimizing the waveguide length involving the radii of air-holes as the degrees of freedom. In particular, the proposed 60° bends significantly outperform previous designs that have comparatively larger footprints. The time domain and frequency domain analysis are done with the Finite Difference Time Domain (FDTD) and Plane Wave Expansion (PWE) methods.

articleTitle: Building an Optimal Model of Cognitive Using KLM and Complexity Theory in Human Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: By the implementation of Keystroke Level model (KLM) in Goals, Operators, Methods, and Selection (GO MS) and cognitive complexity theory over computer interface, a student's cognitive level is scrutinized. When a student answers the questions, the goal factor of evaluation can be measured by the user interaction. The designing of user interface can be developed based on cognitive model by conducting laboratory test to determine the exact task. The time is set as 45 minutes to complete the task for student's test performance. Cognitive complexity theory and Keystroke Level model is specifically used to measure the time task. By the exploit of usability metrics to evaluate in terms of effectiveness test, expertise or efficiency of task and satisfaction test can be processed under usability testing Finally, the system can prove the software quality, based on ISO/IEC 9126-4 Metrics. Moreover, a new calibration curve which can analyze the ability of three independent variable that expresses the goodness fit of corresponding data is discussed for better process in dataset maintenance.

Author Keywords: Efficiency and Evaluation of Usability Metrics

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Vocational Management Information System with R Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Construction of the intelligent vocational management information system with R programming is studied in this paper. R language is a super mathematical statistical algorithm library, with a long history, has a more mature algorithm package than Python, easy to use, simple parameters. In order to describe the above connection function, first introduce the tag tuple. In structured programming, there are mainly three control structures. The first is the core sequential structure, as long as the basic sentence is also reversible, the structure is reversible. The systematic model is validated through the systematic model. The experiment has shown performance.

articleTitle: ROS Based Autonomous Disinfectant Mobile Robot for Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper presents a design of an autonomous mobile robot system, primarily focuses on hospital environments, which focuses on disinfecting the hospital's isolation ward. This paper also primarily concentrates on making this system cost efficient with minimalistic sensors. This system consists of an advance autonomous indoor navigating mobile robot and a ground station, LIDAR, an UVC disinfectant lamp, encoder motors, IMU, etc. and uses ROS to navigate in indoor autonomously, the hospital environment is a busy environment so this paper equally concentrates on dynamically environment navigation, path planning based on global planner algorithms, localisation and navigation is done using particle filter, dwa_local_planner, navfn. The autonomous mobile robot system has been tested and simulated whose results are reliable and efficient.

articleTitle: Opinion Mining Algorithm Based on the Evaluation of Online Mathematics Course with Python
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Opinion mining algorithm based on the evaluation of the online mathematics course with Python is designed and implemented in this study. Natural language is the language used by humans to communicate. When using natural language, it can more or less always leave the user's subjective view of people, things and things. Therefore, texts with subjective content are widely present in our lives. Hence, in this paper, the data mining and the pattern recognition models are used to construct the model. The Python is used and optimized for the systematic design. The framework is simulated on different datasets, the performance is well validated.

articleTitle: Comparison of RLS, LMS and SMI Algorithms for Smart Antennas
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The combination of the array along with the elements of antenna and the algorithm that processes the dedicated signal is known as Smart Antenna. By using this technology, the base station transmits the signal of each user and receives only that in the individual user direction. The technology of Smart Antenna which attempts to inform the problem by using the advanced technology of signal processing is called as beam-forming. Through the beam-forming which is adapti ve, the narrower beam is formed by the base station and nulls towards the users and interfering users. The diverse types of the adaptive algorithms are used to inform the smart antenna weights. Various algorithms of adaptive beamforming used in the current study are Recursive Least squares (RLS), Lease Mean square (LMS) and sample Matrix Inversion (SMI) algorithms.

articleTitle: Predicting the Wind Turbine Power Generation based on Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Extracting electricity from renewable resources has been widely investigated in the past decades to decrease the worldwide crisis in the electrical energy and environmental pollution. For a wind farm which converts the wind power to electrical energy, a big challenge is to predict the wind power precisely in spite of the instabilities. The climatic conditions present in the site decides the power output of a wind farm. As the schedule of wind power availability is not known in advance, this causes problems for wind farm operators in terms of system and energy planning. A precise forecast is required to overcome the difficulties initiated by the fluctuating weather conditions. If the output is forecasted accurately, energy providers can keep away from costly overproduction. In this paper, an end-to-end web application has been developed to predict and forecast the wind turbine's power generation based on the weather conditions. The prediction model has been developed using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory which is a unique kind of RNN (Recurrent Neural Network). It performs admirably in terms of capturing long-term dependencies along with the time steps and is hence ideal for wind power forecasting.

articleTitle: Survey on Object Detection Framework: Evolution of Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Object Detection is one among the most emerging and effective field of interest in the broad domain of Artificial Intelligence. Given a set of images or video (sequence of frames) as input, object detection involves detecting and identifying various range of artifacts in the corresponding image or frame. This in turn includes various categories of detecting an artifact like detecting an object based on its location or detecting an object based on its identity. This categorization of the object detection framework is important because of the ranges of application that's available where these techniques can be applied effectively. This paper establishes a detailed survey which explains the different techniques and algorithms that has paved our way into the object detection framework. Starting from the historical mathematical technique dynamic programming which followed geometric techniques to detect objects, techniques like SIFT, HOG which followed feature level detection and networks like D-CNN, R-CNN, RFCN, YOLO etc. which employs a pipeline of network to detect and segment instance of objects from the images.

Author Keywords: Region based Convolutional Neural Network (R-CNN) and You Only Look Once (YOLO)

articleTitle: Rapid Service - Mobile App for Bike and Car Service
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this modern contemporary era, everyone has a busy as well as hectic lifestyle. So, people do not have any spare or leisure time to go to the garage to repair their vehicles. That's why a mobile application namely ‘Rapid Service’ for bike and car Service System is provided. The application based on Flutter in which one can easily book a bike or car is proposed. Meanwhile, this application works as a mediator as it connects consumers and Mechanics. So, people can book slot for repairing purpose of their car or bike. After the booking, mechanic can see this the pending request list. So, in their spare time, the go to the owner's location and pick up their vehicle. Now the customer can see that their vehicles are on the running holder list, Whenever this repair is going on, the user can see all the details of their bike/car and can also communicate with a mechanic with chat as well as call. Users can also make an online payment to mechanic, as now a days it is used by almost all people. Whenever the mechanic completed repairing, it goes down in the completed holder list.

articleTitle: Concatenative Text-to-Speech Synthesis System for Communication Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis is one of the rapidly emerging areas of computer-to-human interaction technology. Human-like speech is replicated by the computer with the introduction of input text which is usually very natural. Real-life applications of TTS synthesis technique make users task hassle-free. For example, reading book for the visually impaired people, paying electricity bill through automated call-centre, announcing train information at the railway station, etc. Traditionally, rule-based speech synthesis methods are deployed which find difficulties in obtaining optimal rules, resulting in lack of naturalness in the generated synthesized speech. Alternatively, to meet the desired quality of experience (QoE) of users while using these applications, this paper designs and develops a simple and robust TTS synthesis system for English language using the concatenative speech synthesis method and its variants and finds its suitability in intelligible and/or natural speech production. Various steps involved in processing text for speech production through TTS system are described. Results demonstrate that the speech generated by the concatenative speech synthesis method, in particular, unit-selection technique is smoother and natural, sounding like human voice. This is supported by informal listening test of the generated synthesized speech.

articleTitle: Security Attacks on the Improved SMS4-BSK Encryption Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The improved S MS 4-BS K algorithm is a symmetric key block cipher with a message block size of 128-bit. The algorithm is developed to protect the data packets, over the unsecured wireless medium, against cryptanalysis attacks. From the analysis like key sensitivity analysis and the plaintext sensitivity analysis and the security attacks on the design like brute-force attack, Chosen Plaintext attack, Known Plaintext attack, Chosen Ciphertext attack and Ciphertext Only attack,it is evident that the improved SMS4-BSK cryptosystem has the immunity against all the types of cryptanalysis attacks.

articleTitle: Sketch face Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the improvemet of profound understanding in deep learning, face recognition innovation depending on CNN has in reality wound up being the large approach taken. In this paper, convolutional and down-sample layers of CNN are constructed using convolution function. Python's theano library is used for processing pictures. Therefore to beautify on the CNN adaptation the convolution and tasting layers are joined straight away proper right into a solitary layer.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Structure of E-commerce Big Data Clustering Based on Hadoop Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of portable network access equipment and the iterative update of Internet technology, the network ecosystem has gradually grown and become active, which has also led to the rapid development of e-commerce relying on Internet technology. Compared with traditional offline shopping methods, online e-commerce is undoubtedly a fast, efficient and convenient shopping method. The e-commerce shopping platform that has blown out in recent years has also pro ved this point. Based on Hadoop technology, this paper studies the hierarchical structure of e-commerce big data clustering. Based on the construction of Hadoop e-commerce big data analysis model, relying on association rule analysis, classification and clustering analysis, change and deviation analysis, the realization of Hadoop technology-based E-commerce big data analysis.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Parallel FIR Digital Filter Based on Even Symmetric Fast FIR Algorithm using Different Adders
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The ultimate goal of the research work is to analyze the performance of FIR filter designed based on FFA algorithm. The proposed structure aims at area-optimized adders which are designed for symmetric coefficient that reduces hardware cost in the design with a constrain that the filter tap is of even order. Area analysis of silicon chip is performed using different adders like Ripple Carry Adder (RCA), Carry Look-Ahead Adder (CLA) and Conditional Sum Adder (COS). Performance analysis report for a 3 parallel 96-tap filter is considered based on the above adder, where the RCA requires less area utilization compared to other three adders. The symmetric convolution-based RCA Fast FIR Algorithm (FFA) structure requires only 896 slices whereas COS requires 1024 slices and CLA requires 960 slices. For higher-order, FIR filter structure of 1024 or higher taps, the savings in the area utilization for RCA based FFA is approximately 10% and 15% compared to CLA and COS basedFFA respectively because COS requires more hardware building blocks. The RCA based FFA increases the latency by approximately 9% and 7% compared to CLA and COS based FFA respectively, and there will be a trade-off.

articleTitle: Advanced Internet of Things (IoT) Based Technique for Prevention of Road Accidents
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Population in the countries like India is growing very rapidly which results in increase in traffic in cities. WHO (World Health Organization) gave the report of accidents that occurred in the world in 2021 due to the accidents. As per reports around 50% to 60% of the accident cases are leading to the death of the individual. Many reasons state the cause of accidents. One case states that accident deaths occur majorly with two-wheeler riders due to the head injuries. Another case states that due to the drowsiness of the driver. Alcohol consumption is also the major reason for accidents to occur which might result in the loss of life of a driver. Survey done by road safety department states that majority of road accidental deaths are occurring in youth due to rash driving or driving with alcohol consumption. In this work, an advanced way of dealing with the accidents is proposed which further prevents the accidents to occur. An Internet of Things (IOT) based system is designed in such a way that bike or scooter gets started only the rider wears a helmet and also passes the alcohol test. One more methodology is also added where the alarm system gets ON when the driver reaches the over speed. Sensors and microcontrollers are used in the proposed work.

articleTitle: Data Security and Vulnerability Prevention for Cloudlet-Based Medical Data Sharing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: To create next-generation health services, sharing personal health data is essential. A large number of consumers need to group health data into data sets to recognize preemptive and personalized medicine which can be analyzed for the trends of wellness and diseases. Consequently, through cloud adaptability, a new framework of human services is developed in this paper. The cloudlet segments incorporate security protection, data sharing, and interference area. In this paper, another arrangement of medical services is built by utilizing cloud adaptability. The cloudlet capacities incorporate security of protection, information sharing, and interruption discovery. During data collection, a method for encrypting data from user corpses collected through wearable devices by the Number Theory Research Unit (NTRU) is used. These data are energy-efficiently transmitted to the nearby cloud. Second, a new model of confidence which helps users to select reliable cloud data partners is introduced. The trust model additionally assists patients with imparting their infections. Third, appropriate protection of the medical data of users stored in the hospital remote cloud are divided into three parts. A new collaborative intrusion detection method (IDS) is developed to protect the prosperity system against malice attacks, in light of the lattice for cloud, which can successfully stay away from assaults by the distant medical care huge information cloud.

articleTitle: Adaptive Channel Estimation using Least Mean Square (LMS) for Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM)
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In growing technologies, the speed of communication in wireless medium and limited radio frequency (RF) had taken a primary demand for increasing the bandwidth efficient air schemes and power over systems. After the development of cellular telephone system in 1980s. To provide greater system for demand over voice services major evolution in telecommunication sector had come in 1990s. The development Internet Protocol (IP) infrastructure network throughout nation gave rise to third generation wireless voice, multimedia, data services they are namely Wideband CDMA and CDMA2000 and finally to increase its efficiency fourth, fifth generation are developed on demand. Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing, commonly known as OFDM [16]. This OFDM technique of multi-carrier modulation where the data is modulated by the parallelly sub-carriers. These subcarriers are regularly spaced. The main function of sub-carriers is to maintain the minimum separation frequency that is required for maintaining orthogonality of the waveforms which are in time domain. The signal spectra and the sub-carriers will overlap in the frequencies. This overlapping of signal spectra and the sub-carrier gives rise to a waveform which uses available bandwidth efficiently.

articleTitle: Computing cluster and artificial intelligence in the analysis and application of college students' physical exercise behavior
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Computing cluster and artificial intelligence in the analysis and application of college students' physical exercise behavior is studied in this paper. The algorithm is proposed under different scale job sets, the load situation of each node in the entire cluster is relatively balanced, and there is no vacant server situation. By using two algorithms to schedule the variance statistics of the load conditions of each node in the cluster under the same job scale, compare the load balancing performance of the two scheduling algorithms. With the theoretical support, the AI integrated smart training model is constructed, and applied to the physical exercise. The performance is tested under various data sets and the results are recorded to be efficient.

articleTitle: Intelligent analysis framework of sports training intensity based on breathing signal detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Intelligent analysis framework of sports training intensity based on the breathing signal detection algorithm is designed and implemented in this paper. In order to accurately predict the received signal power level or effective coverage of a specific operating frequency band, a lot of research work has been done on wireless communication channels at home and abroad, and our framework is based on the existing approaches. Firstly, the breathing signal detection algorithm is studied using the FCM and FFT, further, the training intensity is combined for the comprehensive analysis. To visualize the proposed model, the system using the novel UI design pattern is designed for a better demonstration. The experimental results on the different scenarios have proven the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Qualitative texture analysis on detection of plant disease
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Maladies to plants have a major impact on both productivity and the economy. To improve agricultural outputs, early identification and treatment of plant diseases are essential. Image analysis is used to detect and categorise a variety of bacterial and fungal capsicum diseases. Using the k-means clustering method, the contaminated region of the capsicum is located, and subsequently, the texture, i.e., GLCM characteristics, are eliminated. Various bacterial and fungal capsicum infections may be characterised by these characteristics (SVM). The KNN and SVM classifiers outperform the tree and linear discriminant classifiers in our application. The technique effectiveness was verified on 62 imageries of healthy and contaminated capsicum and leaf specimens.

articleTitle: Visual Reconstruction Data Point Modeling of Spatial Art in Garden Landscape
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper studies the current urban landscape gardens that can allow people to have close contact with nature through design, and meet people's needs for being close to nature. At this stage, the greening work of landscape gardens can also fully improve the existing ecological environment of the city, which is convenient for my country to build an eco-friendly society. In the process of landscape garden design, space art plays an important role. It is mainly based on space art to model the visual reconstruction data points in the garden landscape. The content of space art design mainly includes the overall topography of the garden, vegetation and planting conditions, and various activity areas. The coordinated design of the garden landscape makes the overall design of the garden landscape more scientific and visually expressive, an increase of 4.6%.

articleTitle: Development of Digital Marketing Technology Based on Physical Data Extraction and Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The thesis starts from the basic theory, introduces the method of physical data acquisition and the concept of data mining. Marketing evolves from traditional marketing schemes to data mining, which leads to the relationship between data mining technology and modern market management. It focuses on the method of obtaining user information and data mining technology in “cross-marketing”, “integrated marketing”, and “integrated marketing”. Applications in “real-time marketing”, “green marketing”, “relationship marketing”, and “network marketing”. At the same time, combined with case analysis, the comprehensive application of data mining in “shopping basket analysis” is discussed and elucidated from the theoretical and technical level.

articleTitle: Understanding Customer Reviews using Facial Expression Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The 21st century marks the beginning of Industry4.0 with data as primary driving force. The abundant availability of high-resolution videos, images of numerous industry processes, human activities coupled with sophisticated data driven technologies stands a base for evolution of latest technologies like image processing, industrial process automation. Here, the aim is to adapt the image processing technology to understand human behaviors based on the facial expressions drawn from various persons and apply that to evaluate customer review in retail market. The objective is to build a deep learning facial expression recognition classification model using OpenCV, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) libraries backed by TensorFlow framework and the trained model is deployed to a web interface using Flask API and generate customer review sheet. Attempts are made to analyze and classify data into 3 customer reviews as Satisfied, Not Satisfied and Neutral. These classification algorithms are deployed to find the real-time facial expression on videos and images to find the probability that an image belong to specific class data and generate customer review sheet.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection Using Local Outlier Factor & Isolation Forest Algorithms: A Complete Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Credit card fraud problem is one of the soared issues in present. A huge economical damage has severely impacted the cusses who are using and connected with the credit card and to tackle it down, one of the most powerful fraud detection technique is the Machine Learning, and for study or research work a vital number of historical data is present by which this article examines various machine learning fraud detection techniques and compares them using performance measures such as accuracy and precision. This planned system also increases the accuracy of credit card fraud detection. Furthermore, the proposed system uses a learning classification algorithm to classify the data and will pop-up the technique that which will be great for detecting the frauds among the global and anthropoids can save loss of millions of dollars due to established system.

articleTitle: Design of Korean Text Resource Information Mining and Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper applies data mining technology to search for Korean/Korean web pages. After a brief introduction to data mining and information management technology, it mainly studies Korean word segmentation technology, topic prediction, and tunnel crossing strategy. The detailed work is as follows: The word segmentation task is the basis of natural language processing. The first task for Chinese, Japanese, Korean and other characters in various tasks is word segmentation. In terms of Korean/Korean word segmentation, traditional matching-based word segmentation methods often require manual construction of a large dictionary, which does not have the ability to recognize words that are not in the dictionary, and the accuracy of word segmentation is not very high.

articleTitle: Smart Home Surveillance System using LDR technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The smart home systems and IoT has seen major developments in recent times. The furtherance in this field has been exceptional and innovative advancements have been made specifically in surveillance field. With the Smart home systems, the security can be enhanced by using unmanned vehicles which includes robotic cars, aerial vehicles like drones etc. This work mainly aims at contributing to the advancement with a novel approach of employing laser detection, sound recognition and face recognition in a robotic car for the security system accompanying smart home system. The smart home system includes the voice command-based appliance control system which can be assisted by a custom-made mobile application. The surveillance robotic car will be alerted with any unusual changes detected by the laser detection system and hence detects any human intervention in the area under surveillance. The robotic car programmed with the obstacle avoidance algorithm allows the car to complete the task without any hindrance due to the unavoidable obstructions.

Author Keywords: Voice command based Smart home system

articleTitle: Neural Network and Machine Learning based Prediction Model Design for Air Pollutant PM10
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The AOI is the measure of pollutants contained in the air. The various pollutants which are generally present in the air are SO2, NO2, ozone, CO, PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> and PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">25</inf>. The present research work is using the secondary data pertaining to the air quality of Uttarakhand. The goal of this work is to design prediction models for predicting the PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> value given the SO2 and NO2 concentrations. ANN (artificial neural network) and ML (machine learning) based prediction models are designed in MATLAB, and their outputs are compared.

articleTitle: Design of the HTML Based Public Service Platform of Hainan Free Trade Port with Big Data and Information Mining Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Design of the HTML based public service platform of Hainan Free Trade Port with big data and information mining model is presented in this manuscript. As the initial study, the safety performance of the model is considered. Encrypt all cloud data to ensure data security, the uniqueness of the key, complete access control, disaster recovery mechanism, and also the data management to further ensure the security and reliability of data. Further, to enhance the performance, the HTML is applied to the data and information mining tasks. The intelligent models and the structure analysis algorithms are applied for the optimal selection. The testing scenario is selected as the public service platform. Efficiency has been finalized through the results.

articleTitle: A real time robust facial recognition model for masked face images using Machine learning model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Almost everybody is wearing a coronavirus mask to prevent the spread of COVID19 effectively. Conventional facial recognition technologies are often virtually ineffective, like Community access monitoring, facial access control, front attendance, and facial security inspections at railway stations. Consequently, recognition of the current masked face recognition technology must be improved as a matter of urgency. The most advanced approaches to facial recognition are based on a deep knowledge based on multiple facial samples. However, the public is currently unable to view any masked facial recognition datasets. In this study, 3 types of masked face recognition data sets are offered, including Masked Face Data Sets (MFDDs) (SMFRD). RMFRD is considered as the largest masked face dataset in the world. These data sets are available to industry and academia to develop various applications on masked sides. The model developed, which masked multi-granularity, achieves 99% precision, and goes further than the industry's reporting results.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Leukemic Gene Expression Profiles using Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Evaluation and diagnosis of any cancer disease is facilitated with the classification of blood cells. Once blood disorders are identified it is easy to classify diseases related to blood. Leukemia is a cancer that affects the bone marrow, which is the producer of blood. Studies reveal that Leukemia can be classified using blood smear images or by taking gene expression profiles. Classification based on gene expressions is of much interest to researchers since it provides an objective, accurate and systematic diagnosis of several cancer types. The present study is an analysis of the classification of gene expression profiles from the classic Golub et al leukemia dataset which reported how gene expression data from DNA microarrays could be used to classify new cancer cases. The present study uses the K-Nearest Neighbors, Support Vector Machines, Naïve Bayes, Logistic Regression, Random Forest and Neural Network algorithms to classify the samples into either Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) or Acute Lymphocytic Leukemia (ALL). Performance evaluation of the various algorithms used is given towards the end of this paper. The results reveal that Logistic Regression provides accurate results and the study reiterates the fact that Neural Networks perform efficiently when the dataset is large.

FLEXCRYPT, a storage system that provides block level kernel support for heterogeneous Full Drive En-cryption (FDE) is introduced in this study. Recent work on Full Drive Encryption shows that stream ciphers achieve significantly improved performance while offering stronger storage security guarantees. However, optimizing for performance conflicts with concerns like battery life. FLEXCRYPT takes advantage of the vast con-figuration space of stream ciphers to balance these concerns with cipher switching. The key insight in achieving low- overhead switching is to leverage the append-mostly behavior of underlying solid-state storage to dynamically optimize for performance, increased battery life, or powerful security properties. FLEXCRYPT is implemented on an ARM big. LITTLE mobile processor and test its performance under the popular F2FS file system. This evaluation shows FLEXCRYPT cipher switching enables secure, flexible, high performance hetero- geneous FDE with reasonable overhead costs.

articleTitle: The Financial Information Management System Mechanism of Domestic Top Three Hospitals Based on Digital ID Technology and Crawler Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Based on the digital ID technology and crawler mining algorithm, this paper studies the financial information management system and mechanism of the domestic top three hospitals. First, it analyzes the financial informationization of the top three hospitals, the top three hospitals, the connotation of financial information, performance management, performance management, and the process of performance management., The purpose of performance management. Then it mainly analyzes the concrete manifestation of financial information in the top three hospitals. Including two aspects: content manifestation and strategic examples. Then use examples to illustrate the direct impact of hospital informatization, especially financial informatization, on medical benefits. Finally, the research system index was constructed by focusing on the expert consultation method, and the efficiency was increased by 7.5%.

articleTitle: Path of Government External Propaganda Work Data Mining and Analysis under the Background of “Internet +”
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Path of government external propaganda work data mining and analysis under the background of “Internet+” is designed in this paper. According to the two characteristics of color uniqueness and spatial distribution, the two have to be combined to obtain the final color saliency map. Since the spatial distribution accounts for a large proportion, the general spatial distribution is expressed by an exponential function. With the further analysis, the data mining model is optimized considering the path optimization algorithm, and the external prior information is integrated to obtain the whole results. The experiment is conducted compared with the latest methods. According to the result, it can be reflected that the designed model has the better propaganda performance.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Ship Rudder Steering Stability Optimization Control System: Modelling and Computer Simulations
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Navigation science and technology has experienced the development process of mechanization, electrification, automation and informatization. The realization of intelligence and autonomy is also the goal of the shipping industry. In recent years, with the rapid development of autonomous system, the application of autonomous technology in the field of transportation has aroused great interest in the industry. According to the working principle of cargo ship and relevant design specifications, this paper summarizes the modeling structure and requirements of the propulsion system, and establishes a simulation platform for the maneuverability of the propulsion system with three degrees of freedom motion based on MATLAB / Simulink simulation software.

articleTitle: A specialized framework of web application for efficient data retrieval on social media tools
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The main motive of this paper is to describe the unique approach of service-oriented web tool development “Social listening”. Which helps to read the real customer thoughts, opinions, complaints, feedback, comments and issues of a particular product on social networks through this paper. The monitoring tools, architecture, design, functional requirements, nonfunctional requirements, and the quality attributes of the system are explained. This entire paper advocate's organized architecture structure which is involved in this web application tool is to mutate high level business information to architecture that implements the customer's voice of goods produced by the companies with the web application tool. However, the architecture shows how data extraction will be much easier, regarding certain products/services from multiple sources like Twitter, Facebook. And analyze the reviews of the customers and convert the result into a graph. The present modeling used in transformation techniques is analyzed, and then a flow-based approach of services is introduced through case studies with an esteemed business description.

articleTitle: Crop Disease Recognition in Smart Farming Using Deep learning Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: India is the second-largest producer of rice, wheat, sugarcane, groundnuts, vegetables, fruits, and cotton in the world. Plant diseases are the leading cause of crop loss. Farmers can boost their productivity by being aware of the state of their vegetable's health. Because of the food we eat daily, many people in our country suffer from chronic ailments due to the high dose of pesticides that not only kill insects but are also present in the vegetables, fruit or green leaves, and therefore indirectly becomes a gradual poisoning for the humans. The model Inception V3 is suggested. The original model relies on categorization convolutional neural networks that have been retrained using the transfer method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Machine Translation of Chinese English News in the Context of Communication Observations and a Priori Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: People of various countries communicate more frequently, and as a new medium for recording and disseminating information, online news, with its real-time, authenticity, and wide coverage, has enabled more and more people to learn more through the window of news. Information from abroad. However, language barriers have become the biggest obstacle to communication and exchanges between countries and people in the region. During the critical period of actively promoting the “Belt and Road” strategy, the demand for translation of news reports, government documents and other texts in various languages has increased greatly. However, manual translation cannot meet the existing large-scale text translation needs. This paper studies and analyzes the intelligent machine translation of Chinese English news based on the background of communication perspectives and a priori model.

articleTitle: Data Collection and Evaluation of Higher Education Informatization based on Grey Convolution
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The rapid de velopment of information technology also promotes the continuous progress of education, especially accelerates the reform of education. Facing the massive and multi-dimensional data of various application systems, it is a new problem for university management to use the data to effectively support the decision-making activities of teaching management. This paper uses the quantitative evaluation method of state characteristic curve to extract the most representative state characteristic curve in different training models. This method can effectively characterize the monotonicity and sensitivity of the state characteristic curve, and finally extract the state characteristic curve.

articleTitle: Missile Trajectory Tracking Using IMM and GNN
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The approach to track multiple missile trajectories from launch to impact on the surface of the earth uses various track and update algorithms, one of such is an Interactive multiple model (IMM) filter. IMM is capable of tracking highly maneuverable targets due to its ability to switch between different tracking filters to track the target at different phases of its trajectory. Global Nearest Neighbour (GNN), a single hypothesis tracker, provides an optimal solution for multi-target tracking. GNN is compatible with various tracking filters which includes Interactive Multiple Model (IMM) filters. Mean square errors of the respective filters are also discussed. Integration of IMM and GNN provides an adequately robust missile tracking system which is discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis and Implementation of Key Technologies in Spoken English Automatic Recognition and Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The rapid development of information and network in the 21st century has changed the way of human life, and the communication between people is more convenient. The research of speech recognition technology has high commercial value. How to use this technology more naturally, reliably and at low cost in business and daily life is its development direction. In the future, human beings can achieve some things more conveniently and quickly through voice interaction, and enjoy more modern services. This paper designs a complete intelligent system driven by voice, including voice recognition, voice evaluation, intelligent dialogue and other core AI technologies. The system allows learners to interact with AI virtual characters naturally, and simulate different application scenarios for training.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Human Resource Management Information System Based on Python and Tree Node Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This article takes Python and binary tree as the entry point, based on the traditional human resource management information system, and conducts in-depth analysis and research on the construction of human resource management information system from the perspective of tree node mining, and analyzes the dynamics of intelligent systems based on Python Sexual needs are analyzed in detail. The research results of this article will propose a new idea to analyze and practice human resource management information systems from the perspective of management and knowledge transformation: when standardized business processes of human resource management information systems are implemented in a company, System results show that the tree node has increased by 7.6%

articleTitle: Design of a Transportation Monitoring System Based on The Internet of Things and A Multi-Sensor Data Processing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of my country's chemical industry, my country's hazardous chemical accidents are on the rise. In the process of transferring these items from the production and storage areas to the consumption areas, road transportation is mainly based on vehicles. Hazardous chemicals are dangerous due to their own dangers and because they are extremely dangerous during transportation, a little carelessness may cause catastrophic consequences. Based on the multi-sensor data processing function of the Internet of Things, this paper studies the design of a road dangerous goods transportation monitoring system.

articleTitle: Simulation and Virtual control of BLDC Motor Drive Using Keil's and Proteus Software
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The primary objective of this research work is to control the speed of BLDC motor. To achieve the speed control, the keil and proteus software are usedto control the BLDC motor microcontroller (AT89C51). The micro controller is used to set the speed ranges, which is done by changing the duty cycles time period in the program. As the frequency and speed are directly proportional to each other by controlling the frequency then the speed is controlled. The microcontroller frequency ranges can be set in the software. The MATLAB simulation tool is used to achieve the BLDC motor speed control and also the torque and speed waveforms will be obtained. The main advantage of this project is to reduce the cost and increase the reliability of this system, which can be more feasible to control the speed of the DC motor in less time.

articleTitle: Analysis of Intelligent Guidance System in English Speech Scenario Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Analysis of intelligent guidance system in English speech scenario under the background of big data is conducted in this study. The dimensionality of the state space reflects the number of variables required to describe the motion in the space. The dimension of a chaotic attractor is the amount of information necessary to describe the chaotic attractor. Hence, in our designed model, this technology is applied to the comprehensive analysis of the performance. Therefore, the speech database used for model training will have a great impact on the performance of the model. The most direct way to improve the speech recognition rate of non-native speakers is to use the speech training of non-native speakers to generate a recognition system. The system is applied from the data collection to the data processing. The scenario is built for the overall analysis.

articleTitle: Smart Secure Healthcare Cloud Data Model By Fog
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Fog computing provides a security model for privacy-preserving healthcare data in the cloud, such as video (surgery footage, endoscope, ultrasound) and images (X-ray, CT scan, MRI). Here, a decoy approach is used to prevent data tampering and information leakage. In the case of video, hiding AES encrypted video inside an image then the output becomes uploaded image and for images use decoy algorithm, blowfish, and Hmac. This paper provides integrity, confidentiality, and availability

articleTitle: Control Strategy of MMC-Based Flexible DC Transmission System in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Compared with the traditional two-level or h-level voltage source converter, modular multilevel converter has many incomparable advantages, such as long-distance high-capacity transmission, asynchronous grid interconnection, distributed generation connected to the grid, wind power generation connected to the grid, passive Island, drilling platform and so on There are broad application prospects in many fields, such as power supply in partial suitable areas, capacity expansion and reconstruction of urban power grid, etc. This paper studies the control strategy of flexible HVDC system based on MMC in cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: CMOS Phase Detector and Phase-Frequency Detector Power and Delay Estimation Using Nano Dimensional MOS Transistors
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A Nano-dimensional transistor phase detector circuit is covered in detail in this article. To demonstrate this, a standard phase-frequency detection circuit is built. Tanner SPICE simulation software is used to simulate the circuit designs. The phase detector circuit's power dissipation, transistor delay, and power-delay product have all been calculated for gate lengths as small as 16 nm and as long as 22 nm. A VDD of 0.5 V-1.2 V also a PMOS/NMOS aspect ratio of 1 to 5 were used in the power and speed study. The phase-frequency detector's power, gate delay, and PDP were all measured at 150 nm channel length. It's now feasible to create a VLSI circuit with fast speed andlow power consumption thanks to recent findings.

articleTitle: English and Chinese Corpus Collection and Intelligent Semantic Recognition System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the help of the part-of-speech tagging in the “Modern Chinese Dictionary” published in 2005 and the “Concise Oxford English Dictionary” published in 2011, the conversion words in English and Chinese vocabulary are compared and found that there are 30 conversion words in Chinese and English respectively. Species and 66 types. This article attempts to introduce the semantic analysis of the English-Chinese parallel corpus into the semantic recognition system. By labeling different levels of the corpus, including grammatical labeling, shallow semantic labeling and deep semantic labeling, the corresponding English-Chinese translation teaching system is designed, and the guiding system is improved by using comparatively systematic data modelling. Compared with the methods without the integration of data mining, the proposed model is more accurate.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Feature Fusion Modeling of Aesthetic and Artistic Elements in Garden Landscape Design
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Chinese classical garden is a wonderful flower in the treasure house of Chinese traditional culture, and it has an important position in the history of world art. It interacts with and interacts with landscape paintings, poetry, and ancient Chinese aesthetics. Through the use of space combination, proportion, scale, color and other techniques, a distinctive artistic feature is formed, emphasizing the harmonious relationship between man and nature, and between man and man. Based on artificial intelligence algorithms, this paper conducts feature extraction and feature modeling of aesthetic and artistic elements in garden landscape design, and studies the relationship between intelligent analysis modeling and garden landscape design.

articleTitle: Visual Communication Data Mining: Novel Approach for Open Project Under the Background of Internet on Enhancing the Professional Practical Ability
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Visual communication data mining with novel approach for open project under the background of Internet on enhancing the professional practical ability is studied in this paper. In order to verify the effectiveness of the learned feature representation, first the feature representation is applied to the clustering problem and measure the effectiveness of the representation by its performance on clustering. In this designed system, the hardware will be optimized. To this end, a general stereo vision model and the parallel binocular stereo vision model are established, and the performance is validated on the database. Compared with the other methods, this proposed model is better.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Clustering Application to Unlabelled Real-time Time-series Data Streams
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The real-time time-series data is often unlabelled and the process time is also limited. Therefore, fair assumption of the solution boundaries for that particular data streams is difficult. In this paper, the different clustering approaches are applied to a domain specific application to analyse the variations in the solution outcomes. For this study, an electrical engineering problem of identifying generator coherency in real-time based upon the measurement data is considered. For time-critical applications, a non-ambiguous and effective response is desirable from the coherency identification methods in real-time. In this paper, the four clustering methods namely, hierarchical, k-means, spectral, and fuzzy c-means clustering are applied to the real-time data clustering problem with undefined labels. Performance and suitability of these clustering methods are studied on IEEE 68-bus system with the help of two cluster validity measures.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the mental health status IoT assisted monitoring of the elderly under the background of big data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Comparative analysis of the mental health status IoT assisted monitoring of the elderly under the background of big data is conducted in this study. Anomaly detection algorithms based on statistics, distance, density, depth and offset are used to analyze the operating status of the equipment in real time and identify abnormal behaviors in the network. Proxy re-encryption refers to the ability of a semi-trusted agent to use the re-encryption key to convert a public key ciphertext intended for the data owner into a public key ciphertext intended for the data consumer, this tool is applied to the monitoring process. The model is tested on the assisted monitoring of the elderly under the background of big data. The model is simulated on the different applications. The monitoring accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis Classifiers for Polarity Detection in Social Media Text: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: People often use the internet and microblogging websites to express their thoughts and opinions on products and services. Sentiment analysis of public opinion is much more important because it aids in understanding the public's views on a specific service and the actions of the consumer who is purchasing a product. This area is expected to be extremely useful in analyzing brand awareness in both the private and public sectors. The proposed survey would aid in the comprehension of the different algorithms that are used to categorize the texts posted into various sentimental categories. The study emphasized that the hybrid algorithms outperformed supervised machine learning approaches with better classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Insights of Deep Learning Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Deep learning is the latest innovation in the fields of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence. Deep learning tries to mimic the human brain, it can intake and process lots of amount of data and also performs complex tasks on them. This report discusses the applications of deep learning and how it can be applied shortly.
