articleTitle: Green and Sustainable Software Model for IT Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The present study is based on developing a Green and Sustainable software because in the present-day computing devices are used for all kinds of purposes and they consume a lot of energy to perform these services. The ICT sector itself consumes a lot of energy so there is a need to think of alternatives that can reduce the level of energy consumption, thus, green ICT practice can be a good option. There is, however, a scarcity of researches that explains how the maintenance of green knowledge in ICT software development may be implemented. Since we recognize that software development process (SDL) plays an essential role in enabling the ICT community, uncontrolled green knowledge in developing software that would lead to the dilemma of failing to satisfy both the community's business and environmental requirements. Therefore, this research will concentrate on presenting a methodology applying an innovative model for managing the green software development and implementation. Keeping this concern in mind the present paper is going to provide a Green and Sustainable software model which can be used in green ICT practices and will be helpful in reducing the energy consumption used by computers.

articleTitle: Building Smarter Smart Cities for Sustainable Development through Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Increasing urbanization and rapid increase of the population in urban areas has led to varied issues, to which rendering the cities as a “smart” one has been identified as a solution. The sole motive behind the intent to come up with smart cities is to incorporate technological impulses into the usual routine chores of people in a particular area, so as to enhance the living standards as well. But there is a gap regarding considering environmental preservation as an indicator of achieving sustainability in the smart city concept. Beyond the current versions of technologies utilized, Artificial Intelligence (AI), is apparently the most promising recent advancement of ICT, which can deliver the motive of sustainable development through the advent of future smart cities. AI applications can actually transform the way civilizations respond to threats of varying degrees. This paper is an effort to showcase in a combined manner, the AI based solutions, aimed at smartifying the smart cities, through focusing on enhancing the sustainable development.

articleTitle: Comparison of Semantic Web Data Performance Using Virtual and Cloud Services
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The term “big data” refers to the rapid development and availability of incredibly massive data collections that can be computationally processed to reveal patterns, trends, and relationships. The term “big data” refers to a compilation of vast amounts of data produced by various sources. Data collection and retrieval are becoming more complicated as the volume of data grows. Big Data Techniques refers to a modern wave of technologies and architectures that are designed to derive information from massive amounts of data in a number of formats. Hadoop uses a massively parallel computing strategy to process data that is scattered through a commodity cluster instead of being processed sequentially. The Hadoop MapReduce Model's mapper and reducer phases aid in the processing of vast volumes of data in a distributed environment, which has an impact on efficiency. Each portion of the data can be separated into smaller bits and stored on a different node within the cluster. With various data loading sizes, nodes were organised using the Amazon web service and the virtual environment. When compared to both frameworks, Hadoop designed in the cloud plays a critical role in data warehousing and clustering to achieve the highest results. As a result, the semantic web data are divided into pre- processing and clustering in this analysis to boost accuracy.

articleTitle: Modeling the Economic and Economic Impact of Artificial Intelligence Data Feature Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the evolution of theory and technology, the impact of artificial intelligence on the economy has become increasingly widespread and profound. Artificial intelligence related topics have become the frontier hotspot of foreign economic research. Traditional economic forecasting models use small amounts of data, few data dimensions, and low forecast accuracy. This article focuses on the systematic study and analysis of the economic impact of artificial intelligence, focusing on the impact of artificial intelligence data feature analysis on urban economy and economics, and the influence of data on economic modeling through artificial intelligence modeling and analysis.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Electrical Network Efficiency With Optimal Placement of TCSC and STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In recent years, due to up-gradation of peoples life styles, industry revolutions, use of electric vehicles, expansion of commercial and domestic loads, lack of capital resources for up-gradation of existing electric infrastructure etc. are causing unreliable and poor operation of the electric networks. The soaring fuel prices and limitation on emission of green house gases, the renewable energy resources are gaining more attention. The effective harvesting of RES and their integration to existing network enhances the overall network performance. Currently, power transmission capacity is one of the bottlenecks of existing electrical infrastructure. Even though with sufficient power generation limitation in TTC of the grid unscheduled load shedding, poor quality supply are common problems faced by the consumers. The use of Flexible AC Transmission Systems (FACTS) are enhances the power transfer capacity of the existing infrastructure up to certain extent. This will defers the new investments in up-gradation of electrical infrastructure. In this paper, optimal placement of STATCOM and TCSC are tested to select best site, number of devices and their combinations to increase overall reliability of the network.

articleTitle: Research on the Security Defense Strategy of Smart City's Substitution Computer Network in Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the information technology era, the era of big data has also arrived. While computer networks are promoting the prosperity and development of society, their applications have become more extensive and in-depth. Smart city video surveillance systems have entered an era of networked surveillance and business integration. The problems are also endless. This article discusses computer network security in the era of big data, hoping to help strengthen the security of computer networks in our country. This paper studies the computer network security prevention strategies of smart cities in the era of big data.

articleTitle: A Novel Electronic Medical Record Design Using Cryptography and Steganography Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Health data is classified as a top priority data to be protected and maintained. Management of paper medical records is difficult as they are prone to theft and misplacement. Therefore, there is a need to provide precise, up-to-date, and complete data about the patients at the time of care. This leads to the era of Electronic Medical Records (EMR) which is a digital solution for management of health records. Current EMR have a lot of challenges like - security, interoperability, lack of Data Analytics, etc. The proposed solution addresses these challenges and provides the functions like - data capture, data storage, data retrieval, data provisioning and data analytics. Double security algorithm which is a combination of both cryptography and steganography has been used to enhance the security. Moreover, the information directly obtained from the EMR provides an insight into methods to enhance delivery of healthcare facilities relying on individual approach towards every patient.

articleTitle: Integration of Artificial Intelligence for a low-cost diagnosis of Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Patients with Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) who do not receive appropriate diagnosis and treatment may go blind as the disease affects the retina's blood vessels. Diabetic retinopathy disease must be detected and diagnosed early if the patient's vision is to be preserved. Specifically, this research focuses on digital image analysis, which has huge benefits in terms of both time and money savings, as well as giving more objective measurements than current observer-driven systems and decreasing the workload required from manually taught graders.

Author Keywords: Non proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy and optic disc

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Twitter Sentiment Analysis on COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Corona virus is a deadly disease that has been spreading around the world for many years. COVID-19 is a new variant of coronavirus which causes its least attack as cold, fever and headache to its severe attack as breathing problems and death. Twitter is a social network tool where a large number of people communicate and express their feelings through tweets and posts in everyday life. Our task is to analyze the perception of people from all over the world during this pandemic. So, analyzing the sentiment of COVID-19 tweets will be one way to find out how people's emotions and the situations are in the world. This system uses various vectorizers, NLP and NLTK tools, which can be used while building various machine learning models for n-grams, and, consequently, to classify tweets into bi-class and tri-class. This system shows a maximum accuracy of 96.7%.

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation System Using Deep Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A Recommender system is a useful engine to predict things according to our interests. This paper explains the recommendation system which is based on the State of the Art Deep AutoEncoders which comes under Model-based filtering technique. Deep AutoEncoders are Artificial Neural Network that is used in Computer Vision and NLP. Here Deep AutoEncoders are used to find Top N recommendation of movies by an Unsupervised learning method. Since the patterns are found using Collaborative Filtering, Netflix three months dataset with implicit values have been used for evaluating the proposed recommender system. This paper is good at predicting the ratings missing from the sparse matrices which is initially provided as input. 20 models have been designed and the best model is linked with the frontend. The RMSE value for the training set and test set is 0.8686 and 0.9365 respectively which tells that this model does not overfit. It is thus proved that Deep AutoEncoders generalizes well.

articleTitle: An Efficient Text Synthesization Method by Utilizing Text Mining Techniques and Natural Language processing for the Usage of Intellectually Disabled Individuals
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Technology is advancing swiftly in current times. Everybody has to learn and update on developments to be helpful and be connected to the community. In this area, visually impaired people and persons with ADHD and dyslexia fall behind due to their inherent limits. To promote their engagement as active members of the community, the technology must be modified. In order to cope with these obstacles, a lot more complete, enhanced, and appropriate techniques than present ones has to be built. When the current Text Rank methodology is updated, it would help prevent wasting time for users by summarizing the whole text. Then the improved method is compared with the present Text Rank algorithms, the Luhn algorithm, the Lex Ranking algorithm, and Latent Linguistic Analysis (LSA). Based on the comparison it is found that Text Rank is an affordable method to do text summarization and to provide an efficient output which is then again used in a machine- learning NLP module which in turn converts text to audio. This would be a useful concept for all types of people. In addition, the system is being constructed on online open-source platforms, making it more efficient and economical.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent semantic recognition framework for English reading APP based on waveform matching algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Design of the intelligent semantic recognition framework for English reading APP based on the waveform matching algorithm is studied in this paper. The vector elements used are not normalized. This is because some signal amplitudes are distributed positively and negatively, which may make the sum of signal amplitudes zero or very small. In this model, the focus will be on APP software structure optimization. With the popularity of modern Ethernet and IP technology. The general collection and transmission of data information and monitoring information has become more and more inseparable from the open network. The machine recognition model is combined for the sematic analysis of the words. The system is then implemented with the optimized structure and the simulation is then conducted.

articleTitle: Application of the open Chinese excellent traditional cultural network community data mining
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Application of the open Chinese excellent traditional cultural network community data mining is studied in this paper. Inspired by the theoretical basis, information flow feature point sets in the different time dimensions and within different time periods are taken as clusters in the general clustering algorithm. With this prior information, this paper proposes the novel network community feature extraction and the analytic model. The data mining is implemented with the adjustment of the abnormal data sets. The proposed model is applied into the excellent traditional cultural network construction. The model is then simulated and the experimental results have guided the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Real time visual interpretation for the blind
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Blindness is a very common and unendurable disability among many disabilities. According to a report from WHO, there are 285 million visually impaired people. This paper presents the idea of developing a smart system that can assist visually impaired people. Visual impairment is one of the main problems for humankind. Those people need assistance to perform day-to-day tasks. People can live a simpler and more efficient existence thanks to technological advancements. However, not everyone shared this sentiment, as some people with impairments, such as the blind, continue to suffer in life despite the availability of technology or smart devices to assist them. Here we are coming up with a system to help those people, to experience the surroundings by real-time interpretation in which the visually impaired people don't need another person to interpret. Our idea is a mobile application and visually impaired people can use their smartphones to interpret the real world. A voice-controlled smartphone application in which, upon a specific command, a visual is captured and processed back into a meaningful sentence. This text is then passed through a text-to-speech model which converts it into the language preferred by the user. As a way of interaction through voice input, our program employs voice user interface technology such as speech recognizing and speech synthesis.

articleTitle: Real-Time COVID-19 Infection Risk Assessment And Alert System Using Mask Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The onset of COVID-19 pandemic has led to many life-style changes, among them is the usage of Face masks to protect themselves from the deadly virus. It is recommended to use face masks, but it is a common practice for people to forget wearing it. Sometimes both the nose and mouth are not covered leaving them at a risk of infection. The purpose of this paper is to alert shopkeepers or property owners about the risk of spread of Covid virus due to the non-usage of face masks. By monitoring a place for number of people wearing and not wearing face masks, one is able to be aware of potential risks people carry. The owner is alerted about the count of non-masked people when it reaches a certain threshold through a siren and also through an alert message sent on a popular messaging platform. This way, one can persuade people to wear masks or to leave the premises, thereby protecting himself and others. This paper uses VGG Face model, OpenCV and TensorFlow and a custom trained mask detection model to achieve the same.

articleTitle: Salp Swarm Algorithm for Hierarchical Cluster Head Selection in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The sensor nodes are positioned in random locations for monitoring the environmental conditions in WSN. The sensor nodes are cooperatively passed the entire information to BS. The sensor node is operated by using the battery sources and also used to perform sensing, computing, and communication. These processes need additional energy for data processing and affect the lifetime of the network. The clustering method provides an efficient solution for handling the network lifetime issue. In this paper, the salp swarm optimization is introduced in the LEACH-C to choose an effective CH. The proposed algorithm is mimicked by the salp behavior in the ocean for generating the salp chain. The salp chain is generated by using the leaders and followers for balancing the exploitation and exploration phases of optimization. Salp swarm algorithm is used to select the higher residual energy of the node and minimum distance between node and base station for CH selection. The proposed methodology is evaluated with energy consumption and network lifetime. The proposed method extends the lifetime of the network and minimizes energy utilization.

articleTitle: Innovation and Application of Computer Multimedia Aided Mode Method in College Online English
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the gradual realization of globalization in various fields, interlinked languages can quickly shorten the distance between people in different countries and lay a linguistic foundation for the development of individuals and countries. Since the formation of language is closely related to culture, it is necessary to understand the culture of the people using the language in order to eliminate conflicts caused by cultural differences. At present, bad teaching results have appeared in college English teaching. This paper studies educational communication theory, cognitive load theory, multimedia courseware interface design theory and other teaching theories, and SPSS analyzes teaching data.

articleTitle: Diaper Wetness Detection Based on Sensor and Using IOT
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Wearing a wet diaper for an extended amount of time will cause dermatitis. To avoid the dermatitis, diapers should be modified in a very timely manner. In this paper, diaper wetness detection system is introduced that sends a notification to parent's smart devices whenever the elimination event happens. The IOT based system detects the wetness with the help of DHT11 sensor which senses the increase in temperature and humidness on outside of the diaper. It is a little size and reusable wetness detection system that is hooked up outwardly to the baby diaper.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model of Domestic Animated Films and Audience Psychology Based on Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Nowadays, the wave of new media has swept across all walks of life, penetrated into every aspect of people's daily life, and has had a huge impact on domestic animated films. The production and dissemination of domestic animated films are changing to focus on the needs of the audience. Based on the facial expression recognition algorithm of deep learning, this paper establishes a model to predict the audience psychology of domestic animated films. This article uses the three levels of “audience sensory needs”, “audience aesthetic needs”, and “development status and countermeasures” of animated films in the new media environment as the research basis, combined with deep learning algorithms, to make accurate estimates of audience psychology.

articleTitle: Fake Tweet Data Analysis using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: As social networking websites have grown in popularity, so has the amount of data being generated online. M any people set up social media profiles to share their thoughts, images, and videos with the world. There are various ways for people to express themselves succinctly on Twitter, for instance. Twitter is a service that allows users to collaborate with one other. Tweets like this one might launch a worldwide movement for change or a global debate. It was necessary to classify them, and just the tweet itself could be posted. Kaggle's KFC challenge, dubbed “the M cDonald's of AI,” provided the data for this piece. Approximately 40000 tweets were analysed in this study. Cleaning the data using Inverse Term Frequency (TF-IDF). Clean data may be analysed using SVM, RF, and Decision Tree classification algorithms (DT). With an accuracy rate of 88.51%, the Decision Tree algorithm is the most reliable. The accuracy, recall, precision, and F1 of this result are evaluated.

articleTitle: Survey on Disease Detection in Plant Leaf Using Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Plant disease is a major threat that causes a decrease in agriculture productivity and also affects food security. Deep learning methods play a major role in plant disease detection. Existing and ongoing disease detection models are investigated in this paper. Recently, the research on plant disease detection using images in deep learning has been done, and also research types may require a huge number of dataset and it is arduous to extract. Thus, data augmentation to image-based plant disease detection is proposed to solve this problem. Data augmentation is more effective in so many cases in getting a huge dataset. This paper investigates and provides an overview on plant disease detection to analyze the most contemporary methods, developed over three years leading up to 2020, for training, data augmentation, feature extraction, detection, and counting crops recognizing the diseases including how these methods can be employed to feed deep classifiers and their effects on classifier accuracy.

articleTitle: Korean Grammar Error Recognition Algorithm Based on Big Data Corpus and Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Korean grammar error recognition algorithm based on big data corpus and semantic analysis is studied in this paper. Data mining directly faces massive data, and there are also some various complex relationships between these data, which leads to the surge of search space and search dimension in the mining process. Based on the traditional methods, the semantic analysis and the big data framework are combined to construct framework for the recognition algorithm. The component analysis method is mainly used in the field of word meaning research, and its use premise is to divide the word meaning into different semantic components, this model is applied into the grammar error recognition. The performance of the model is efficient, and the application scenarios are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Follow-up Management of Blockchain Venture Capital Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In recent years, constrained by the overall downturn of the global macro economy, the venture capital industry has encountered bottlenecks in raising funds and potential projects at the same time. In the past, “white horse” projects that have become popular based on the concept of “Internet +” have gradually decreased, and the hottest ones are now the “unicorn” project is difficult to control because of the accumulation of investment bubbles. Therefore, “hoarding goods for the winter” has become the main theme of the current venture capital industry. At the same time, venture capital companies have also begun to review the extensive investment concepts and management models of the past “throwing beans into soldiers”, and began to pay attention to the post-investment management of investment projects. This article studies the follow-up management of cloud computing-based blockchain venture capital.

articleTitle: Novel interactive model for voice recognition for machine assisted English training system
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Novel interactive model for voice recognition for machine assisted English training system is designed in this study. Based on the scale frequency curve, the relative frequency deviation can also digitally determined, that is, the relative deviation of the relationship between the actual record section and the individual scale frequency, as the numerical basis for quantifying out-of-tune. The general audio signal is not mixed with any voice signal in the first short period of time, but there is background sound, which will not be an absolute silent segment. The separation algorithm is used to achieve the machine assisted English training system. The model is tested on the different sets of the signal frequency. The accuracy is much higher.

articleTitle: Implementation of DCT and Fractal Compression Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Digital images are required in various sectors and it requires a large data set to depict them, their transmission and storage mechanism is time-consuming. The information in the photos is optimized by extracting only fundamental signals to displays the visible portions. The storage and transmission costs are often reduced by compression. During image compression, graphics file size is decreased in bytes without compromising the image's quality beyond an acceptable level. Methods like DCT, DWT, etc. are used for image compression. Blocking artifacts are contains by this compression technique. To overcome this challenge and compress the image efficiently, hybrids of DCT and fractal compression techniques were created. Because DCT is utilized for color image compression, fractal compression is used to avoid repetitive compression of comparable blocks. The PSNR, SSIM, and Compression ratios are considered to analyze their effects.

articleTitle: Advanced unique smart card verification system for Validation of university certificates with AES and LUHN algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: As per reports, many fake certificates are being produced by the people for admissions into further studies or getting recruited to any company. Though third party verification system are being availed by the companies, it is very time consuming and also lot of investment is to be done on human resources for this work. In college or university admissions also, fake certificates are troubling a lot for authorities of admission if the certificates produced are identified as fake after giving the admission to the student. This makes ambiguity in the admission process. In present days, digitization of all kinds of transactions is being encouraged. Certificates verification system is also to be digitized in maintaining the integrity of university certificates. In this paper, a hybrid system for securely validating digitized university certificates with combination of an AES (Advanced Encryption Standard), LUHN (Modulus 10 Algorithm) and Shake 128 is proposed which not only digitizes the certificate verification process but also provides more security.

articleTitle: Comparison of Emotional Speech Detection Algorithm for Glottal Closure Instants
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Epochs or glottal closure instants are periods of high vocal tract stimulation during speech production. Among other applications, GCI extraction is utilized in prosody modification, speech synthesis, and voice source analysis as a pre-processing step in speech technology. . Many of the GCI detection techniques developed throughout time are compatible with speech signals produced by modal phonation, thus these algorithms work well with them.” For emotive speech, however, a comparison of several cutting- edge GCI detection methods is required. Emotional speech and well-known evaluation criteria are used in this research to evaluate GCI detection techniques. This collection contains recordings of seven distinct emotions, as well as factual information like electro glotto graphy(EGG). All six GCI identification algorithms perform well in neutral emotion speech processing, but they struggle in high arousal speech processing (anger and joy). GCI detection in emotional speech may be aided by local average pitch period estimates, according to the findings of the study.

articleTitle: Deep Learning in Agronomic Forecast
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In India, Agriculture plays an imperative role in the development of our country. More than 50% of entirety populace of India is directly or indirectly depends on agriculture and the agronomist are the backbone of the agronomic diligence but the agricultural backdrop facing decades-long tribulations and unpredicted challenges that are so critical to resolve. Some of the major issues that agronomist finding hard is water scarcity, soil erosion, lack of market intellect, poor quality of seeds, usage of fertilizers, inadequate knowledge on preserving soil for further cultivation etc. In addition to this, due to Covid19, still more problems faced by farmers are shortage of agri-inputs, lack of laborers and transportation of farm products. In order to rectify some of the agricultural tribulations, this paper has been primed as an effort to re-evaluate the study on the significance of deep learning techniques in the domain of agro crop yield production and rainfall-temperature forecasting with respect to density. The objective is to build an application that is user-friendly for the agronomist suggesting legitimate crop selection fine points according to the crop year, zone, season, soil nutrient on their farm which hikes the yield of the crops devoid of fertilizers and preserving the soil composition without degradation as well. This work integrates finding soil nutrients such as Nitrogen, Potassium, and Phosphorous. The input parameters considered for predicting the crop are likely the district, the crop year and the previous crop planted. Based on the survey, Artificial Neural Networks(ANN), Convolutional Neural Network(CNN), Decision Tree, Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Random Forest and Support Vector Machine(SVM) classification models are the best models to predict accurate values and obtained the optimized results.

articleTitle: Cross Retrieval of Document Resources in the Libraries of Colleges of Traditional Chinese Medicine in Parallel Clusters
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Library document resource sharing is an important symbol of library development, and knowledge storage and retrieval is the key technology of library document resource sharing and dissemination. Based on the parallel cluster research, this paper takes the construction of the document resource guarantee system of the libraries of Chinese medicine colleges and universities as the object, conducts cross-indexing of document resources, and compares the differences between different systems, so as to rationally organize and scientifically organize the document resource guarantee system of Chinese medicine colleges. There is a clearer understanding of the layout. The current literature resource retrieval methods based on catalog classification, keywords, etc. lack semantic information and cannot satisfy users' retrieval requests, and the indexing efficiency is improved by 11.2%.

articleTitle: Application of Learning Data Sparse Coding Algorithm in Online English Guiding in the New Media Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Application of the learning data sparse coding algorithm in online English guiding in new media environment. This paper proposes an improved tracking algorithm based on the sparse coding representation model, which processes the tracking target into partial blocks and performs sparse coding on the partial blocks. By minimizing the objective function, the basic distribution difference from different modal data is reduced, and the similarity information between the same modal data is retained, and then, the system is implemented through the analysis of the new media integration. The system is implemented though the testing and the results are presented.

articleTitle: Study on Supply Chain Intelligent Design System of Foreign Trade Enterprises under the background of Internet
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the introduction of one belt, one road and the “Silk Road” strategy, and the deepening of supply side reform, the cross-border electricity supplier market in China has developed rapidly and has penetrated into key links such as production, circulation and services. In this paper, the complete experimental model is imported into unity 3D platform to complete the development of dynamic effect of three-dimensional experiment. Finally, the virtual experiment system is published in the form of web page. At the same time, this paper uses Quartus II to write FPGA, and completes the construction of hardware circuit. The hardware data transmission interface and the virtual data receiving port are set to complete the data transmission.

articleTitle: Antifraud Model For Internet Loan Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Nowadays everyone has moved to online. In the same way frauds are also increased on internet. Although there are many approaches to detect these kind of frauds, they are not accurate. This has to be enhanced This research work make use of random forest and XGBOOST algorithms. This research work uses a big public loan dataset, such as that from Lending Club, to detect fraud. A random forest is used to fill in the missing values initially. The most discriminating features are then chosen using the XGBoost algorithm. Such a basic and successful model could improve the use of machine learning for detecting the frauds in Internet loans, which would help financial engineers.

articleTitle: Mutual entity authentication protocol for mobile cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Mobile cloud computing offers a combination of both mobile computing and cloud computing services. Mobile cloud computing has many advantages like high mobility, high availability, high accessibility, adaptability to different types of devices of various configurations and screen sizes. Despite these advantages, MCC has its disadvantages. The disadvantages include connectivity issues, performance issues, and security threats to the data stored in the cloud. [5] Mobile cloud computing provides data transmission through an insecure channel with the help of the internet. So there is a possible risk of security threats or attacks like man-in-the-middle attack, impersonation, masquerading, etc. For providing a solution to these problems, there is a need for an authentication protocol that ensures secure data transmission. A protocol named Mutual Entity Authentication Protocol is defined, which will help us overcome the limitations possessed by Mobile Cloud Computing. This protocol uses an OTP to authenticate the user. [4] The OTP is formed by concatenating the username, password, and IMEI number of our mobile phone. [6] The OTP generated is encrypted by Triple Data Encryption Standard Algorithm in which a randomly generated key given to the algorithm is helpful for encryption. This protocol also uses Data Encryption Standard Algorithm to encrypt the files uploaded in the cloud. Not only for the 3DES algorithm, the key generated for the DES algorithm is also generated randomly. The protocol proposed is implemented and tested using Java EE to show its efficiency in authenticating the user and providing security during the data transmission. Compared with the existing protocols, the proposed protocol results demonstrates that it delivers better security for user's authentication and data transmission.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Activity in Untrimmed Videos Using Dense Optical Flow and Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Computer Vision is playing aremarkable role right from essentials to entertainment and thus trying to turn computer as a “seeing” machine. Having widespread applications in most of the real world domain like healthcare, surveillance., space and social media, yet it is still challenging to match human intelligence in understanding the underlying context. Recognition of a task performed by human is important to learn the happenings, but predicting it, from the activities” initial subset becomes an aid to overcome adversities in near future. Numerous algorithms and techniques are present, yet a gap exists due to the environment in which it is recorded, illumination condition,overlapping of men and materials on captured scenes etc.These lead to the requirement of high power computing devices for recognition, which is considerably costly.In this work, Dense OPnet (Dense optical flow and Convolution neural Net) is proposed which takes in the RGB input video, converted to dense optical flow frames and then fed to three layered CNN for recognition and early detection of an activity using N/2 frames of the total input video. This method is evaluated on two benchmark datasetlike J-HMDB21 and UCF50 giving an accuracy of 93.4% and 74.3% on recognition, 68.2% and 50.24% on early action detection respectively.

articleTitle: IoT Based Engineering Calculator using BOLT IoT Module
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: IoT plays a significant role in today's life. Calculations are inseparable from our daily life especially engineering problems. It is the key idea that developed in this project. IoT primarily based Engineering calculator goes to be a classy version of traditional scientific calculator, but with implementation of IoT. Here, the idea is to break the traditional way of carrying a calculator for exams. So a straightforward liquid show alphanumeric display calculator for basic engineering problems using Arduino UNO, Bolt cloud and an internet app is to be developed by the team. Calculating the simple and complex engineering problems and displaying it in a webpage and also to send the response back to the hardware based using the REST APIs of the web app. It'd be helpful in things where the scholar could not be furnished a full internet device style of a laptop computer or movable for his exams. The backend may be updated therefore new calculation algorithms could be introduced anytime if needed. This project will be easy to setup or to install during the examination. It suitable for most of the operating systems, also be a portable one. Hope this idea will be helpful for colleges and organisations for conducting exams and research studies.

articleTitle: Smart Space Data Sensing and Internet based Empirical Study on the Innovation of Modern Online Educational Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Smart space data sensing and the Internet based empirical study on the innovation of modern online educational technology is conducted in this paper. Because the optimization scheme of data storage is affected by the characteristics of the data set itself and the user's personal query needs, it is difficult for the system to judge the structure and analyze the needs of the data set from the beginning. Hence, for the global optimization, the data sensing model is optimized and the empirical study are both conducted. The proposed method is simulated on the data sets collected. The efficiency testing is done.

articleTitle: Design of Java Interactive System Pattern based on Computational Thinking
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of data types, the workload of software development is also increasing, and the later maintenance of software becomes very difficult. According to statistics, the vulnerability related to complex data processing occupies a large proportion of software vulnerabilities. The existence of software vulnerability makes the software system vulnerable to attack and affects the reliability of the software system. In this paper, the upper computer system uses the HashMap structure to store the query data directly in the structure and reduce the mapping process from data to table objects. After that, the rationality of the system module is analyzed by building a complex network model, and the robustness of the system is improved by finding the key nodes.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Auxiliary Function of Computers in Mathematics Applications in College Engineering
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Discussion on the auxiliary function of computers in mathematics applications in college engineering is conducted in this paper. In Von Neumann's system, the storage model achieves work at the expense of space or time, which essentially limits the improvement of information processing capabilities. With respect to this idea, this paper considered the computer system optimization on the engineering applications with the math models. The computer organization and architecture course provides the basic theory of SoC composition structure and on- chip IP core module interconnection mode for SoC design. Hence, the novel fuzzy model is applied to enhance the structure. The designed model is simulated on the different database. The core performance is tested, and prospects are discussed.

articleTitle: A Personalized Advertising Push Framework Based on Measurement Similarity and Data Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Efficient and accurate screening of key information with high credibility and user interest from massive information and data is one of the research focuses of the information service industry. The pull service method based on search engines and the information push service are currently the two main channels for obtaining information. The level of economic development in rural areas in my country is lagging, and farmers' cultural qualities are generally low. It is not realistic to adopt search engine-based information acquisition methods, and information push services are more suitable for rural areas. Based on the measurement of similarity and data integration, this paper studies the personalized advertising push framework used in the Internet era.

articleTitle: Odia Handwritten Numeral Recognition: A Hybrid Modelling Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The task of recognizing characters and numbers from handwritten images has a wide variety of applications in today's world In this paper, a deep hybrid learning approach using transfer learning to classify numbers from handwritten images of regional language Odia numbers was implemented. The performance across various optimizers on VGG16, and even among various traditional machine learning classifiers, were compared. Each of the networks was trained for 50 epochs, with ReduceLR on plateau as a callback mechanism to make the model learn the parameters better. Augmentation techniques such as image shearing and rescaling to further generalize the model.

articleTitle: Video-Based Abnormal Driving Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Abnormal driving includes the distractions like talking/ using mobile while driving, operating radio, eating, doing certain action like reaching back while the vehicle in motion. All these activities are related to endangerment of life and accident are prone. With the help of AWGRD network model using deep learning fusions, the state of driver at a particular frame of time can be determined and warned with a level of accuracy. There are, many models are present which are used to predict the state of driver like WGD, WGRD, AWGRD out of which AWGRD is better because it takes super positions of other layers, so the accuracy level increases. Our model predicts the behavior of driver by taking the help of ten classes which are ordered according to their state of activity.

articleTitle: New Ideas of Building Energy Saving in the Era of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Today, global warming caused by excessive emissions of greenhouse gases has become an increasingly serious problem. The construction sector is one of the largest energy consumption areas, so it is imperative to implement total energy consumption control in the building sector. In this paper, starting from the source of the establishment of building energy consumption quota, sampling investigation is conducted on various typical public buildings to collect energy consumption and related factors such as heat transfer coefficient of envelope structure, operating parameters of air conditioning, personnel density, etc. Then, the statistical data of SPSS software was used to find out the sample distribution probability, and the energy consumption level and energy consumption characteristics of the whole public building were analyzed. In order to verify the validity of the prediction method, the monitoring data of building energy consumption recorded by a college of environment was used to conduct an experiment.

articleTitle: Design of the Fusion System of Teaching Resources and Enterprise Resources under Intelligent Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: School-enterprise integration is the essential feature of vocational education. Vocational education is developing rapidly, and the number of vocational colleges continues to increase. The combination of the production and teaching can not only improve the quality of talent training in vocational colleges, but also a useful method to increase the ability of vocational colleges to serve the society. Based on intelligent data analysis and deep learning algorithms, this paper systematically designs the integration of teaching resources and enterprise resources in school-enterprise integration, and improves the degree of integration of school-enterprise integration.

articleTitle: Design Of Cuk And Single-Ended Primary Inductor Converter (SEPIC) For PV Systems Integration To AC Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In the year 1920, the DC-DC change technology was first settled. The most straightforward method of changing over the DC-DC voltage transformation is a voltage divider or rheostat, creating a load voltage lesser than the graceful voltage with diminished execution. In the light of the Cuck and Single-Ended primary inductor converter (SEPIC) topology, whose non-stop information is reasonable for PV applications and decrease massive capacitors channels on the information side, this article is described by the course and arrangement of DC-DC as a response to the high conversion ratio requirements. The high-conversion DC-DC converters are considered a crucial part of integrating PV-based systems in AC or HVDC grids. This article introduced four different topologies dependent on Cuk/SEPIC converter courses and series associations for fulfilling these requirements.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Modeling of Factors Affecting Energy Consumption of Urban Residential Buildings and Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This research first reviews domestic and foreign research on building energy efficiency and building energy consumption factors. Based on literature research, it studies the demographic characteristics, building characteristics, lifestyle, energy-saving awareness, and equipment characteristics that affect the energy consumption of urban residential buildings. 29 indicators in each aspect. Based on the analysis and screening of the above four influencing factors, a multiple linear regression prediction model based on correlation analysis is established. This model is different from the traditional linear multiple regression analysis and modeling. All factor variables of energy consumption are included in the model, but the redundant variables of the model are eliminated after correlation analysis and partial correlation analysis. The results show that the accuracy rate of energy consumption is 97.5%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithms for the Prediction of Daily Mean Solar Power
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Daily Mean Solar Power is the main factor that is taken into consideration while a solar panel is being installed. The average solar irradiance data which is collected from the NASA satellite is being used as input to the model. The results obtained from the model showed the amount of solar energy that can be generated before any installation of solar panel at a given location by using the Machine Learning(ML) Algorithms. To predict the mean solar irradiance three regression algorithms are being used along with its parameters that are linked to solar irradiance. In the given work there is representation of a comparative analysis among these machine learning algorithms. Furthermore, the data is divided into four parts i.e. prediction of solar irradiance for one week, one month, one year and fifteen years data. This data is applied for three algorithms namely Decision Tree Regression, Linear Regression, Support Vector Regression. And the algorithm which produces least root mean square error is selected for prediction.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Crime Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The criminal cases in India are increasing at a faster pace. Due to this reason, the number of pending cases are piling up. Due to this increase in the number of pending cases it has become a difficult task to solve these cases. For the prevention of future crimes, the identification of the crime patterns of an area is very important. Different criminal solving agencies can be better at providing a good understanding of the pattern and pattern of criminal activity in a specific domain. Machine Learning can be used to find criminal activity patterns using different algorithms in a particular location. Criminal data are used to predict crimes in an area that helps our country to reduce crime rates.

articleTitle: Computer Aided System Design of Fashion Design and Decoration Process under the background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Marx said: the real contents of all epoch-making systems are formed due to the needs of the period in which these systems came into being. The research on the value system of fashion design is not only beneficial to improve the theory of fashion design, but also to promote the development of fashion industry. In this paper, based on MATLAB platform, a set of program is developed to extract the edge features of digital image and convert them into layout, which is applied to “contour processing”. This method can improve the efficiency and reliability of layout design, then detect the image boundary, and finally use GDS toolbox to generate the exposure layout.

articleTitle: Forecast of Cycle Measure of Logistics Vehicle Delivery Route Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the acceleration of the global economic integration process and the rapid development of science and technology, the role of logistics activities in global economic activities is becoming more and more important, its status is becoming more and more prominent, and its impact on all aspects of global economic activities is becoming increasingly obvious. Especially with the development of e-commerce websites, logistics has gradually become an important area of competition for current enterprises. The purpose of logistics distribution is to provide customers with the best service at the lowest possible cost, thereby improving the overall economic efficiency of the enterprise and enhancing the overall level of competition of the enterprise. Based on the improved genetic algorithm, this paper studies the prediction problem of the circulation measurement of the logistics vehicle distribution path, and opens up new ideas for the reasonable arrangement of the logistics path and the minimum NP problem.

articleTitle: Development of Smart Solar Tracker-An Approach towards Self Governed Tracking Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel smart dual axis solar tracker to optimize the energy consumption in tracking mechanism. In conventional approach high torque motors are employed to continuously hold and mobilize the solar PV panels, which lead to excess energy consumption by motors, resulting in less efficient tracking systems. This issue is addressed by optimizing the panel rotation and detachment of motor shaft after directing the panel to sun's direction. The tracker includes two parts; main SPV plant of 60 W and miniaturized tracker with 10 W panels. LDR Sensors are located on miniaturized panel to track the sun's direction and this tracking mechanism of miniature model is utterly dependent on direction of irradiance only. Further, DC motor coupled to main SPV panels will rotate as per the signals of the miniaturized model and thus miniaturized model acts as decision making unit. Comparative analysis of results revealed that, performance of the system has increased by 15-35% at varying irradiance values.

articleTitle: Intelligent Data Collection and Analysis of Sports Heart Rate Detection Equipment: from SVM to KSVM
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Inspired by the novel kernel analysis, this paper integrates the SVM to design the intelligent data collection and analysis of sports heart rate detection equipment. Data mining processing technology is a process of instinctively searching for the special relationship between the hidden data from the large amount of accumulated data collected by ourselves. Considering this basic function, the IPM is considered as the core model. Based on the random subset summation method, this paper constructs a new summary structure for the data flow in a single window, and proposes an algorithm to solve the query problem and then apply into the scenario of sports heart rate detection equipment. Through the testing on the performance, the model's robustness is validated.

articleTitle: Efficient Data Sharing using Multi-authority Attribute Based Encryption in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The process of data exchange relies heavily on attribute-based encryption. The secret key can be shared with other users for transactions and it does not contain any user-related data. The attribute authority creates the secret key from a collection of attributes. It is difficult to tell whether the authority or the other nodes are providing the altered private key. When the structure of access control in a dispersed network is flawed, sensitive information is exposed. The efficiency of attribute-based encryption is a hindrance in its applications. Data is more reliable and approved because to blockchain technology. In the suggested system a multi-authority attribute based encryption is been implemented. The attribute bloom filter is used in access control and to hide attributes. The performance and security analysis reveals a safe and efficient privacy system.

articleTitle: Computer Recognition and Conversion of the Painting Style of Characters in the Murals of the Tombs of the Northern Qi Dynasty
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Based on the computer image recognition technology, this paper selects the images of the people in the tombs of the Northern Qi Dynasty as the research object. Through the investigation of the images of the people, including the subject matter, layout, and modeling characteristics, the computer recognition and image conversion technology are used to try to outline the image of the people in the tombs of the Northern Qi Dynasty. The overall style and outlook. This paper uses feature extraction to extract pixels from the image of people in the tombs of the Northern Qi Dynasty in different regions, and discusses the commonalities and differences among them. Then, in the vertical historical context and horizontal historical pattern, the images of people in different eras, regimes, and artistic categories were compared with those in the tombs of the Northern Qi Dynasty, and the difference was reduced to 4.5%

articleTitle: Performance analysis on the electrical behaviour of Zinc oxide based nanowire for energy harvesting applications
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A piezoelectric energy harvester using nanowires in an effort to improve the electrical behavior when subjected to low frequency mechanical vibrations is presented. The electrical characteristics can be improved by using semiconductor nanowires. Also, the conductivity of the nanowires are improved when added with impurity aluminum. Compared with one dimensional nanostructures the present 3D nanowire based energy harvester demonstrated better results. The obtained results are compared with other relevant research works with respect to area Vs electrical parameters. It is found that the proposed structure of energy harvester proved to provide better results.

articleTitle: Smart Farming: An automatic water irrigation and animal detection model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Agriculture activities have become smart enough t o assist farmers by developing automatic water irrigation and animal detection models. The proposed system assists them in both the fields and in the sale of the product that they cultivated in their own field. Any farmer can use the application for both selling and buying. It has some features in which the proposed system can detect animals that enter the field and we use a sound source to distract animals that try to enter the field. An automatic water pumping system has been developed for the agriculture field based on the water requirements of the plants or crops grown in the field.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Distribution Optimization of Emergency Supply Chain under the Background of Communication Network Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Entering the century, with the rapid development of my country's economy, and the frequent occurrence of various natural disasters and public health events, emergency logistics has received more and more attention from government departments and scholars. As a special form of logistics, emergency logistics has received more in-depth research and development, and related academic achievements have emerged one after another. The corresponding emergency logistics equipment and work efficiency have also been effectively improved. Based on the background of communication network data, this paper studies the resource allocation optimization plan of emergency supply chain.

articleTitle: A Review paper on Optimized Reconfigurable Cell Array
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Optimized reconfigurable cell array (ORCA), which can support larger data path designs on a nibble basis, without decreasing its support for random logic control applications. This can be implemented by providing a programmable function unit that is equally adapted to environmental conditions. The routing structure is designed so that it can allow nibble of data to be moved around the chip efficiently, without interrupting other individual connections that characterize based on high logic data paths. ORCA-Top chip is implemented using various CMOS technologies. Based on the specifications of ORCA-Top, RTL logic is written and converted to gate-level netlist by synthesizing the RTL logic. In this review paper, the various ORCA architecture implementations has been discussed.

The purpose of this article is to provide an overview of the types of scenarios that lead to variations in the tension, the protection of the fixture will now change, and the implementation of the protection of the encryption algorithms of different manufacturers may result in a similar relay function are different and react.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Power Quality through Optimized Cascaded MLI based Shunt Active Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Due to increasing sensitivity of the power equipment in utility system the term Power quality (PQ) has acquired point of discussion for the researchers. In recent times, active filters like shunt series and their hybrid topologies are the proven solutions to eliminate the PQ issues. Such filter topologies are facing few problems regarding space and time characteristics. In this paper, a cascaded Multi level Inverter (MLI) acting in place of conventional Voltage source inverters (VSI) solves the above-mentioned problems i.e harmonic mitigation in current. This is further enhanced with intelligent metaheuristic techniques. The well-known PQ theory is for reference signal generation and SPWM technique is used for pulse generation required for active filtering device. The dynamical simulations are carried out with MATLAB/SIMULINK toolset.

articleTitle: Inverting and Non-Inverting Operation of Ac-Ac Buck -Boost Converter Using Fuzzy Logic Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In this paper, creative design proposes an inverting and non-inverting buck-boost transformer. This theory is based on the assumption that people make decisions based on non-numerical and imprecise data. Indefinite models, approximate sets, or approximations characterized by fuzziness (hence the term fuzzy). They are capable of recognizing, reflecting, viewing, and processing ambiguous data. It regenerates dynamic voltage to compensate voltage sag and voltage waveform drift when used as a DVR. It has no shoot-through challenges since it is a bidirectional meter. Also, no RC snubbers or other workarounds are used. Also, MOSFETs can be applied with no diodes conducting, and for freewiring, the diode functionality can be used to eliminate the problems caused by reversing the current draw. Experimental data and rigorous study of a 300-W prototype is available.

articleTitle: 3S Forest Fire Prevention Construction Intelligent System based on Communication System Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Forest is the main body of China's ecological construction and an indispensable part in the realization of China's sustainable development strategy. As of September 2017, China's forest area has reached 205.8 billion hectares, and the forest coverage rate has reached 21.93%. At the same time, as a big country of forest resources, forest fires occur frequently. This paper proposes hourglass architecture and sparse gradient compression from two aspects of system architecture and communication data compression to reduce the communication overhead of distributed training deep neural network. The algorithm is used to speed up the training process to ensure the accuracy loss within 1%.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of rural protection and reconstruction effect based on remote sensing information fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Evaluation model of the rural protection and reconstruction effect based on remote sensing information fusion is studied in this paper. The annotation accuracy of the data set has a direct impact on the prediction effect of the model. The higher the labeling accuracy, the better the prediction effect of the two models, and the higher the evaluation index values, hence, for the better evaluation of the model, the annocation model is considered to capture the remote sensing image data. The advantages of feature-level image fusion are that a large amount of the image information is compressed and real-time processing can be then realized, then the fusion model is used to construct the efficient framework. Through the experimental testing, the different aspects of performacne are tested.

articleTitle: Design of Reproductive Health Guidance System Based on Internet and PHP Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: This article discusses the role of the Internet and PHP-based information systems in promoting reproductive medicine. Using the method of combining literature review and the use of hospital reproductive information system, the classification and various characteristics and functions of the “Internet + assisted reproductive technology” information system are studied. “Internet + PHP architecture” is divided into information systems used by medical staff in medical institutions and information systems that focus on communication between doctors and patients and the needs of patients. The hospital information system improves the work efficiency of medical staff and improves the management effect of the departments.

articleTitle: Review on Nanoelectronic computing approach: Quantum Dot Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Quantum Dot Cellular automata (QCA) is an upcoming research area to achieve computation easily. This computation technique does not involve transistors, and thus it demands less computational cost and power requirements. Huge device density with ultra-low power consumption at reasonable costs is turned the adiabatic switching property with QCA. The working principle of QCA is supported with the principle of electron interactions within the quantum dots principal to the materialization of quantum features and limiting the problem of potentially integrated circuits to size. The logic gates and circuits can be intended with the help of the least amount of QCA cells and without crossovers. Hence, similar devices can be adopted to build complex circuits. This article presents a study in the works carried out in the QCA field in the last two decades. Moreover, the fundamentals of QCA are being discussed, and a comparison of various multiplexers designs presented in different papers is also made. The QCA Designer design tool is used for the simulation of QCA designs.

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Forensics Face Sketch Recognition using Fusion Based Deep Learning Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: To identify a drawing from a picture, first recognize the face.
