articleTitle: Distributed Multi-Dimensional Data Index Strategy in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The widespread application of cloud computing technology makes data show an explosive growth trend, and poses new challenges to traditional data management technology. Existing cloud storage systems generally use distributed hash tables to access data. This key-value-based model can achieve higher access efficiency in single-dimensional queries, but it does not support multi-dimensional queries. Therefore, in recent years, cloud storage auxiliary indexing has become a hot topic in academic research, and related results have been published in top international conferences and top journals in the field of database. This paper studies the distributed multi-dimensional data index strategy under the cloud computing environment. The work of the thesis is carried out from two aspects: multi-dimensional data index in cloud storage and distributed computing.

articleTitle: Strategies to Reduce the Sense of Cultural Alienation among Ethnic Minority Internet Era based on Information Smart Transmission Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Strategies to then reduce the sense of the cultural alienation among the ethnic minority Internet era based on the information smart transmission model is studied in this paper. Studies have shown that evolution has led to the formation of a signal transmission game system. Generally, under the standard dynamic evolution, the transmission state should evolve in the form of the positive probability. Good transmission control technology can fully improve transmission speed, processing speed, information accuracy, and information security. Hecne, this designed model is efficient for the applications.

articleTitle: Course Recommendation System in Social Learning Network (SLN) Using Hybrid Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Each and every day, a lot of courses are published online by various mentors to help the interested people learn online. But the students who are interested may find it difficult to associate themselves with appropriate course they want as there are so many courses available, even under just a single topic. To help select the best courses for the respective candidate, here a course recommendation system is designed with the concept of hybrid recommender system. Recommendation systems such Content-Based filtering and Collaborative filtering have their own advantages and disadvantages. So, to compensate the shot comes of the respective filtering models, both the models are combined to realize a hybrid recommender system for the Course Recommendation in the Social Learning network. Here, the content-based filtering uses Lasso algorithm and collaborative filtering uses KNN algorithm, and to combine the result obtained by both the filtering methods, weighted average method is used to gain the result as a hybrid result from both the filtering models. This will prove to perform very well with great efficiency for the Course Recommendation in Social Learning Network.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Emergency Rehabilitation Management System for Large-scale Public Health Events Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Our country is in the transitional period of economic transition society, facing complex contradictions, coupled with natural disasters, accidents and disasters, public health and social security exposure of the inharmonious issues, there is the possibility of various public emergencies anytime and anywhere. Therefore, no matter from the perspective of field, frequency, scale, organization, etc., my country is in a period of frequent public emergencies at this stage. This paper studies the architecture design of a large-scale public health incident emergency rehabilitation management system based on machine learning.

articleTitle: PWM algorithm for Dual three-phase PMSM driving system
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous motor (DT-PMSM), a novel overmodulation algorithm is proposed. In non-sinusoidal voltage modulation area, based on the space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) algorithm, minimum amount of harmonic voltages injected in the harmonic subspace are calculated using improved four-vector space vectors. In order to simplify the PWM hardware and software implementation, the modulation algorithm is implemented with three-phase decomposition PWM, which can generate symmetric pulse width modulation waveforms. And it can transit from sinusoidal voltage modulation region to non-sinusoidal voltage modulation region smoothly. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm has been validated in experimental in a Dual-three PMSM driving system. Keywords-Dual-three PMSM; overmodulation; four vectors SVPWM; three-phase decomposition PWM; harmonics suppression

articleTitle: Impacts of Cloud Computing in Digital Marketing
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In modern day of digital marketing the cloud computing is proving extremely beneficial links for businesses. Moreover, it's characteristic to access the stored data from anywhere makes it more popular among the entrepreneurs. The present paper is an exploration of the cloud computing in respect of digital marketing. The paper defines and correlates the term cloud computing, digital marketing, as well as also elaborates about benefits that can be harvested by the integration of cloud computing in digital marketing strategy.

articleTitle: Cluster Analysis of Influencing Factors of Regional Economic Growth Based on Random Walk Model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: The development of circulation in China should vary from place to place. There is a curve relationship similar to the marginal productivity between the elasticity of the circulation industry and the regional economic aggregate. With the gradual deepening of China's reform and opening up, the financial market continues to develop, and the degree of trade integration continues to deepen. However, the development of China's regions is extremely weak. However, the problem of balance has become increasingly serious along with development. This article analyzes the influencing factors of regional economic growth in different regions of the country, and clusters the influencing factors based on the random walk model. The results show that the model is effective.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Data Technology in Computer Graphics Scene Reconstruction under the Background of “Internet+”
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the wide application of virtual reality technology, computer graphics and multimedia technology in various fields, people are paying more and more attention to the research on modeling and rendering methods of highly realistic 3D models, while traditional modeling methods are cost-effective There are unavoidable shortcomings in terms of speed and applicability. Under this premise, because image-based 3D reconstruction technology can directly extract texture from images, it can easily and quickly reconstruct a highly realistic 3D model. Received extensive attention. Based on virtual data technology, this paper studies the application of computer graphics scene reconstruction.

articleTitle: Parking Tracking System Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Based on rapidly growing population we face a lot of difficulties in our day to day life. One such issue is when we have to search a parking space for our vehicles in parking area. Four wheeler users are very common in this era and with huge number of vehicles, we need a better system to provide a clear idea about the availability of parking space and at the have time have to ensure the safety. There are many researches which provide a solution on this problem but those researches failed to provide accurate results. In this paper, the system designed clearly enables the parking tracking facility with good accuracy and at the same it also establishes a safer parking lot system that consist of fire detection alarm and petrol leak alarm. This system consists of Raspberry Pi setup which is used to give the data about the availability of the parking space. If the car is pre book the slot, it allows the car into the parking slot allotted for it, if the car is not pre booked the slot the parking amount will be debited from the amount in the card. The details will be displayed in the LCD. If any fire accident or any fuel leakage occurs in the parking area, the alarm will be on to alert the persons around the parking area. This paper proposes All vehicle information is recorded in the database, and the relevant tags and tag ids are supplied to users so that the system may access all information.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of System-Level Simulation for 5G Cellular Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the rapid progress in technology, it is expected that 5G technologies are projected towards approaching people, data, objects, applications, cities, and transport systems in sensible networked communication conditions. The capability of the immense volume of information would change considerably more rapidly, dependably provide extremely numerous appliances, and manage incredibly significant quantities of information, including insignificant delay. Nevertheless, the requirement of protocols of TCP in attaining the performance for developing the sizable capacity of air link capacity and the performance enhancement for the upcoming networks and the technology mm-Wave (Millimetre-Wave). The paper highlights the proposed framework for modelling mm-Wave and its analysis employing the ns-3 simulator. The context is validated over numerous simulation circumstances to evaluate the protocols against the mm-Wave with the measuring factors such as Congestion Window size (CWnd), Round Trip Time (RTT), and Throughput. Also, the characteristics of 5G simulations were addressed compared to 4G simulations, particularly centred on system-level simulation, and the outcomes have been validated through experimental analysis.

articleTitle: Using Wearable IoT Devices to Analyze Healthcare Data for Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Now a day's wearable sensors have gained lots of importance in the field of healthcare researches. Utilizing wearable IoT (sensors) for analyzing health parameters has become more reliable. But in the present scenario the W-IoT which are used, needs to be improvised as there are few complexities in the design and the monitoring abilities. To overcome this, a system is designed which uses linear regression algorithms to analyze the wearable sensors data. All the information gathered from the wearable device applied to the liner regression algorithm where the analysis is made, and the outcome is displayed on the things board server and the update are sent to the mobile application. With this, the reduction of complexity can be achieved and also reduce the human effort by constant monitoring of the patient.

articleTitle: Facial Recognition based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Human beings are the inquisitive creatures, who are fascinated by several things. One of the things that captivate their interest more than anything else is humanity itself. One of the primary tasks in the investigation of ethnic gathering recognition is facial component disclosure. Exceptionally, with the new innovation of profound learning techniques, significant research progress has been made in computer-based facial recognition. This paper has proposed a deep learning model for identity recognition by considering the facial features. According to the recent research studies, due to the distribution of identity/race in preparing datasets, biometric calculations suffer from cross-race impact, where their display is better on the subjects closer to the “country of origin.” To begin, this research work has compiled a dataset of various identities/races and further prepared and examined four state-of-the-art convolutional neural networks on the issue of race and ethnicity characterization. The purpose of performing such analysis is to illuminate activity, assemble proof for hypotheses, and incorporate it to create information in the field of profound learning. These tests and an acknowledgment pace of 82.0% on the human race arrangement issue that exhibit the adequacy of proposed arrangement.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Sports Industry Information Software Architecture Based on Mobile APP
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Sports APP is an inevitable product that conforms to the development trend of information technology in my country, meets the needs of users' sports informationization, and promotes the in-depth implementation of national fitness sports. It is also the combination of mobile Internet and my country's traditional sports industry, and the rapid development of the Internet and the in-depth implementation of national fitness Under the promotion, a new way of dissemination of sports information has emerged. In order to deepen the knowledge and understanding of sports APP, this paper studies the reconstruction of sports industry informatization software architecture based on mobile APP, and further analyzes the detailed categories of sports industry informatization.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Surveying and Mapping Technology in Construction Engineering Survey Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the continuous development of the social economy, the current digital application technology, global positioning system technology, geographic information system technology, remote sensing control technology and other new scientific and technological forces have been widely used in engineering surveying. After more than 20 years of scientific research efforts, my country has finally made great progress in engineering surveying and mapping technology, and established a complete digital surveying and mapping system, which proves that my country's engineering surveying has been in line with the world. The development of big data technology in the new era has opened up new applications for digital surveying and mapping technology in construction engineering and geological engineering. Based on big data technology, this paper studies the characteristics of digital surveying and mapping technology and its application in engineering surveying.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Analysis of Dynamic Charging of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Electric vehicle is gaining importance due to its advantages such as zero emission and less running cost. The charging systems for such vehicles is ever evolving. The concept of static and dynamic charging is well proven concept that are followed by the manufacturers worldwide for charging of the vehicles. This research work provides a novel method of charging the electric vehicle using a simple magnet and coil technology. Electromagnetic analysis of the proposed method is carried out to find out its reliability and effectiveness and also helps in coil designing.

articleTitle: Restaurant Rating Prediction Using Regression
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Opening a new Restaurant has been a challenge especially in current times due to tough competition and variety of choices for a consumer. Thus, Rating of a restaurant becomes an important parameter for judging the quality of a Restaurant. A good rating acts as an invitation for new customers. And every new business wishes to know if it will succeed in future or not. The purpose of this paper is to provide validation for new Restaurants about their predicted Ratings. By inputting various factors that are characteristics of a planned Restaurant, one is able to predict the average Ratings and if necessary, provide a comparison between various options of a particular characteristic of the Restaurant. It can also help one in making the right choices before the action of opening a new Restaurant is implemented. Thereby securing them against investment losses, saving time and making the whole process a well thought out calculated risk. Seven different types of regression models are used to make the predictions by considering factors that can be easily controlled before setting up a new restaurant and finally model metrics are compared to choose the best regression model for future prediction.

articleTitle: Improvised CNN model to Predict SARS by Detecting the Localisation of Proteins
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Having extensively plenty of humans on earth, each one of us is made up of enormous number of cells. Every human being on this earth is different and unique, even in genetically identical twins, scientists are able to identify differences between the genetically identical cells in their bodies. Therefore, discrepancies in the localization of proteins can also lead to such cellular heterogeneity. Therefore, the identification of mis localized proteins may hint at cellular dysfunctions, advancing our knowledge about diseases. Proteins plays a highly important role in almost all the cellular processes in our body. Most frequently, many different proteins come together at a specific location to deploy a function, and the exact result of the task is based on the available proteins. It is important to know why and how proteins occur to completely understand how cells functions, how diseases develop and ultimately how to develop better treatment for those diseases. To comprehend the complexity of human cells, it is essential to segregate the mixed patterns across a wide range of human cells. Our primary aim is to predict localization of the protein organelle among 28 different labels, where each sample is being imparted by “The Human Protein Atlas” using high throughput microscopy. The “Human Protein Atlas” was initiated by Sweden to locate all the proteins in cells, tissues, etc. All the data in the knowledge resource has open access which allows anyone to explore human proteome. High throughput images from Human Protein Atlas provide a rich source of information on the protein location which can be utilized by computational methods. The proposed paper focuses on deep learning image analysis methods and, in particular, on Convolutional Neural Network which is effective at determining sub cellular locations. CNN outperforms all the computing methods and reaches close to perfect localization with accuracy of 96.6% significantly outperforming the best human expert with an accuracy of 72% and shows an improvement of 3% over the other existing models.

articleTitle: Reduce Estimation Error Rate and Power in Database Center During Query Processing & Query Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Data centers are well-known for consuming a significant amount of energy. When it comes to server and data center op erations, energy management is becoming more important, with the goal of reducing all energy-related expenses, including capital and operating exp enditures as well as environmental implications. One of the most power-intensive applications in a data center is the database application. The primary goal of a conventional database is performance, which implies that queries must be completed as quickly as possible without any concern for energy consumption. This paper will look at the amount of energy used by a database server during query processing and optimization. As a result, this research work will develop a power and energy estimation model and compare it to an existing model. Result: Include experimental results demonstrating that our technique is more accurate than the current method.

articleTitle: Prediction of Hot Topic in Social Media Based on User Participation Behavior in Social Hotspots
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: In social networks, the messages by the user plays a crucial role in determining the trending topics and participation behavior of the user. Considering, this communication between the different users in multi message interaction and complex behavior of users, this paper proposes a prediction model of hot topics based on the user participation behavior in social hotspots. By considering the sentiment of message and forwarding behavior of user, a model for prediction of user participation behavior was proposed. Considering the participation behavior of user with Back Propagation neural network that can consider complex user behavior and non-linear relationship, the hot topics in the network are predicted. The influence of the messages is constantly evaluated under a particular topic in the interaction between the users. This paper not only predicted the hot topics, but also gave accurate results with the use of BP neural network

articleTitle: E-mail autocomplete function using RNN Encoder-decoder sequence-to-sequence model
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Text Auto-complete feature suggests a stream of words which complete a user's text as the user types each character. Such a feature is used in search engines, email programs, source code editors, database query tools etc. Earlier people have used traditional language models for this problem. But for better performance, a Neural network-based language model is needed. Here, an encoder-decoder based sequence-to-sequence language model has been used for performing text generation and the empirical results show that the model effectively suggests the incomplete sentences.

articleTitle: Trust Mechanism on the Relationship of Community Residents Based on IoT and Video Tracking Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Trust mechanism on the relationship of the community residents based on IoT and video tracking algorithms is studied in this paper. Decentralized dynamic trust management and safe and transparent use of user sensitive data and cloud services are essential. However, the identity alliance has significant security and tracking risks, and does not protect user privacy well. Hence, the trust model with blochain is essential. The situation of the general platform in this article is that one receiving end corresponds to multiple sending ends and this IoT framework is then applied into the community. The experimental results are simulated with modelling.

articleTitle: A way to explore SMS: Social Media Scams for a secure Digi-world
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Social media is a revolutionary phenomenon, which deals with how consumers look for information, interact with their work and communicate with one another. There are billions of active users in various social medias like Twitter, WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram with numbers that go up to one million every day. This provides way for criminals to use a wide range of tactics to connect and commit fraud. Constantly using innovative ways to access the personal data is achieved by Scammers. Social media scams degrade the trust of consumers. This paper focuses on scams and provides different ways to various agencies to improve safety and minimize harmful damages. It helps in upgrading the consumer awareness on social media scams which is the heart and soul for a secure Digi-world.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition with Faster RCNN and RPN for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Transportation systems are used for movement of people from one place to another to satisfy their needs. Roadways are the major transportation system used for travelling. As the traffic is getting increased, signs in the roadways are not clearly visible for the driver, which in turn leads to road accidents. In order to avoid the accident, Intelligent Transportation systems are designed. In this work, Traffic Sign dataset is taken and labeling is done. The dataset is divided into classes and with the usage of Faster RCCN and RPN networks signs are recognized. Then Random Forest algorithm is used for performing classification and regression in the given dataset. This model gives an increased accuracy closest to 100.

Author Keywords: Faster Region based Convolution Neural Network (CNN)

articleTitle: Transfer Learning Approach For Predicting The Calorific Value Of Food
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Food is the most important part that determines our health, it is vital for us to know what we eat and keep track of our nutrient intake to maintain a healthy lifestyle. In this project, a food recognition system is proposed that detects the food and displays its nutritional contents based on previously stored data. An object detection method is adopted to achieve this purpose. This model is built by training the manually built dataset using TensorFlow API and Single Shot Multibox detection (SSD) MobileNet model pre-trained on COCO dataset. The output is in an easy-to-understand format where it displays the name of the food detected along with its calorific value.

articleTitle: Interface Design Element Analysis and Data Perception for Mobile Platforms
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: With the development of the mobile Internet, smart phones have become standard equipment in people's lives, and there is fierce competition among mobile terminal manufacturers of various brands. The design style of the mobile phone system is the bridge for the brand mobile phone manufacturers to convey the brand concept to the users. Before users experience the system functions, they will first notice the style and taste of the system UI. Therefore, the stylized design of the system UI is very important. At present, the research on static UI interface design style is relatively mature, but most of the research on dynamic effects focuses on interactive functions, and there are relatively few researches on dynamic brand styles. This paper studies interface design element analysis and data perception for mobile platforms.

articleTitle: The Photovoltaic System Step-Up Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: A high step-up converter is recommended for a front- end photovoltaic technique. An asymmetrical interleaved high step-up converter gets high step-up gain without operating at an excessive duty ratio. A standard boost converter and connected inductors make up the voltage multiplier module. An additional conventional boost converter is used in the first phase to provide a significantly greater voltage conversion ratio. The two-phase architecture decreases current stress across individual power switches while simultaneously limiting input current ripple, lowering conduction losses in metal-oxide- semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs). Furthermore, the recommended converter functions as an active clamp circuit, reducing high voltage spikes in the power switches. Therefore, the MOSFETs which are lower in voltage can be chosen for decrease of conduction losses in the system as well as the cost. The energy which will be saved to spillage inductances is reuse at the yield terminal with move forward effectiveness. In this project, those model reenactment circlet for An 24-Volts enter voltage, 380-V yield voltage, Also force yield about 1000W. Yield force may be used to check its execution. Effectiveness will be recorded similarly as 96.3%.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Sign Language Corpus of Tourist Attractions under the Background of Big Data Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Construction of intelligent sign language corpus of the tourist attractions under the background of the big data information retrieval is discussed in this paper. The distributed fusion system is that before the detection report of each sensor enters the fusion, its own data processor generates the local multi-target tracking track, and then sends the processed information to the fusion center, which is based on the data of each node. Considering the above advantages, the designed model adopts the SQL model, and the information mining and retrieval algorithms are combined to construct the efficient smart system. The proposed model is simulated on the collected public massive data set. Through comparing with the other traditional methods, the proposed framework performance better.

articleTitle: Status Quo Intelligent Evaluation of the Network Security Legal Awareness: Modelling and Simulations
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Status quo intelligent evaluation of the network security legal awareness with modeling and simulations is studied in this paper. Through the security risk assessment of the network system, various network security issues that appear in the application process of the network system can be effectively dealt with in real time. Proxy firewall technology is aimed at personal computer users who need to use a proxy network. When personal computer users access remotely through a proxy server, they often need to then lower the personal computer firewall protection level due to the need for data transmission. With this requirement, this paper proposes the novel modelling method to construct the efficient system. The experiment has proven the satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Design of Parallel Big Data Stream Transmission System Based on Chaotic Migration Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of severe node congestion, low data transmission rate, and low data integrity in the current parallel data transmission process, a method for controlling the integrity of parallel data transmission in a big data environment is proposed; the integrity control principle of parallel data transmission is used to control the parallel data during transmission. Obtain and measure the two major interference factors of transmission congestion for analysis. In order to solve this problem, a parallelized big data streaming system based on migration learning is proposed. This paper studies the design of a parallel big data stream transmission system based on chaotic migration learning.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Classification of Different Region Pop Songs using Spotify Database
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Music Information Retrieval is a field that is interested in extracting information from musical compositions whether it is songs, instrumental pieces or scores of various genres. With the development of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques, better models are used to infer songs and scores. These inferences are later used in detecting copyright breaches, categorizing songs as per user, developing music recommending applications and many more. Though our understanding of music has increased tremendously, linguistic based research has been limited. The work in this paper focuses on analyzing data-sets of songs of different Indian linguistic communities on the basis of some predefined musical parameters like speechiness, loudness, acousticness etc. The only similarity is the songs in comparison of different languages have the same mood or valence (positiveness). This work will help to understand how different linguistic music having the same mood, has different musical features. The method used for this project is Multi Class Neural Network for training and thus testing the data-set. The data-set is collected from a popular music app using the inbuilt Application Programming Interface (API) of the app.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Intelligent Safety Measures for Building Construction Based on Internet Information System
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Computer aided intelligent safety measures for the building construction based on the Internet information system is studied in this paper. The architecture of an information system does not refer to a specific information system, but a summary of the common characteristics of all information systems. With this basic feature, this paper adopts the Internet info-system as the basis for the model design. In the sensor network topology, the most used are star type, mesh type, and star-network hybrid type. Each topology has its own advantages and disadvantages, and the advantages of different models are selected to construct the efficient model. The combincation with the contruction engineering is studied and simulated. The designed system can help the process intelligent and smart.

articleTitle: Information Flow Optimization for Practice of University Mathematics Interaction Platform Construction
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Information flow optimization for the practice of the university mathematics interaction platform construction is studied in this paper. To construct the efficient model, data access signals are sent to the two systems on the same client, and both systems receive the access request at the same time and apply relevant methods to process the data access request. The WAN information access control system based on the information flow model is a core public system, and the operator needs to have an independent module to operate the WAN information access control. With these ideas, the platform is conducted for the implementations. The experimental results show the efficiency of the designed model.

articleTitle: System Design and Effect Evaluation of English Online Teaching in Higher Vocational Colleges Under the Influence of the New Crown Epidemic
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Affected by the new crown pneumonia epidemic, primary and secondary schools across the country have conducted online teaching. Online class teaching guarantees students' study hours during the epidemic and helps them to better complete their learning tasks, thereby effectively ensuring the suspension of classes during the epidemic. However, in the actual work of online teaching, there will also be large and small problems. These problems will affect the quality of students' learning. They are also the content that teachers need to pay attention to, and relevant teaching design and teaching should be carried out according to the actual situation of online teaching. Arrangement of the plan. This article will analyze and discuss the problems of online teaching and the classroom design plan of online teaching.

articleTitle: An Image Depth Information Extraction Based on Parallel Random Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 5th International Conference on Electronics, Communication and Aerospace Technology (ICECA)
abstract: Computer vision is mainly used to study the application of computers to simulate human and biological visual system functions. Its research goal is to enable the computer to have the ability to recognize 3D scene information through one or more 2D images, that is, to use the computer to realize the perception, understanding and recognition of the objective world three-dimensional scene. Computer vision is not only an engineering field, but also a challenging research field in the scientific field. This paper introduces a parallel stochastic evolutionary algorithm, by proposing a new evolutionary algorithm for solving multi-objective minimum spanning tree, extracting image depth information.
